incompetech.title: Firebrand
incompetech.description: Super fast percussive piece with polynesian rhythms mixed with a fusion of large modern drums.

incompetech.title: Rite of Passage
incompetech.description: Nice laid-back tribal all percussion piece with overtones of polynesian music.

incompetech.title: StompDance
incompetech.description: Starts slowly, and accelerates, ending on a quick note.

incompetech.title: Tikopia
incompetech.description: The feel of this percussion pieces switches from straight to swing several times, but always has a round wooden sound to it.

incompetech.title: Gaslamp Funworks
incompetech.instruments: Machines, Brass, Organ, Cellos, Percussion, Glockenspiel, Xylophone
incompetech.description: It is 1895, you just got your new brass-rimmed monocle, and you want to head out to see the new gigantic music machine that was just constructed... Roaring 1920s fun, 1930s art music style bridge... it is the retro future of music.

incompetech.title: Super Friendly
incompetech.instruments: Electric Piano, Choir, Synths, Drum Kit
incompetech.description: Starts easy, builds, and releases easy again. Sort of like a happy triumph. Eucatastrophe, even.

incompetech.title: Supernatural Radio A
incompetech.description: If you're looking for that late 40s/early 50s sci-fi or supernatural radio drama - this is your piece. This was rendered on a hammond, using only the drawbars that would make it over the radio (no bass).

incompetech.title: With Regards
incompetech.description: Music for a vigil. Very chill, almost hymn-like.

incompetech.title: Senbazuru
incompetech.description: Beautiful warm and calming piece with a Japanese sort of sound. A low end synth provides deep support.

incompetech.title: Amazing Grace 2011
incompetech.description: Tasteful version of the classic religious piece.

incompetech.title: Melodie Victoria
incompetech.description: Ragtime-like music box theme with an unexpected-sounding bridge section.

incompetech.title: Tabuk
incompetech.description: An epic plodding middle-eastern sounding piece. Grab your camels!

incompetech.title: Comin Round the Mountain
incompetech.description: Electro-acoustic rendering of the famous American folk song.

incompetech.title: Cortosis
incompetech.instruments: Timpani, Basses, Trumpets, Trombones, Tuba, Violins, Percussion, Flute, Oboe, Clarinet, Bass Clarinet, Cellos
incompetech.description: Fight sequence in a galaxy far, far away. Several changes of feel throughout.

incompetech.title: Cupid's Revenge
incompetech.description: Celestial themed video game music.

incompetech.title: Gloom Horizon
incompetech.description: Mournful piece with a nice melody. Melody starts at 40 seconds in. Feel free to chop out as much opening as is required. The low beat is a bass drum with the attacks cut off.

incompetech.title: Industrial Music Box
incompetech.description: Music box with 2 ranks of tines, and one set of bells.

incompetech.title: Industrial Revolution
incompetech.instruments: Cello, Pipe Organ, Trombones, Horns, Trumpets, Tubas, Percussion
incompetech.description: A sort of steampunk industrial piece with a lovely melody.

incompetech.title: Ropocolypse 2
incompetech.description: With a name like "Ropocolypse", it is probably digital and gritty.

incompetech.title: Mandeville
incompetech.description: Minor reggae groove with a cool triplet delay piano bit.

incompetech.title: Montego
incompetech.description: Modern yet classic reggae piece. Starts with a classic video game riff.

incompetech.title: Yallahs
incompetech.description: Dark tones and a wah guitar in a modern-mix classic-sounding reggae piece.

incompetech.title: Airport Lounge
incompetech.instruments: Bass, Drum Kit, Electric Piano, Vibraphone
incompetech.description: Light and airy, this piece is guaranteed not to steal focus.

incompetech.title: Hackbeat
incompetech.description: Only obliquely Latin, I didn't know how else to classify this one. No melody.

incompetech.title: Medusa
incompetech.description: Crazy dark and intense, this piece has a ton of atmosphere, and subtle digital effects. See also: Steel and Seething

incompetech.title: Motivator
incompetech.description: Classic style corporate-presentation rock piece.

incompetech.title: Steel and Seething
incompetech.description: Nice build-up and release. See also: Medusa

incompetech.title: Virtutes Instrumenti
incompetech.description: Based on 11th century sacred music, this piece can set you way way back in time almost instantly. Several faster and slower sections are available during this piece.

incompetech.title: Virtutes Vocis
incompetech.description: Based on 11th century sacred music, this pieces carries melodies only, and no words.

incompetech.title: Enchanted Journey
incompetech.description: A harp solo in several distinct sections. It works well as a contained piece, but also contains several smaller sections that stand alone.

incompetech.title: Pale Rider
incompetech.description: Yes. A solo harp piece with an old western edge. I'm not sure why this hasn't been done before. Probably because you don't imagine a cowboy riding with a harp slung over his horse. It works, though.

incompetech.title: Funeral March for Brass
incompetech.description: A simple new funeral march; atypical in the fleeting moments of triumph.

incompetech.title: Breakdown
incompetech.description: A rock standard drum kit kicks out a quick and steady beat. The simplicity of the music calls for simple content that is driving and powerful without being overbearing.

incompetech.title: Covert Affair
incompetech.instruments: Bass, Electric Piano, Drum Kit, Trumpet
incompetech.description: The scene is set for a surreptitious heist or furtive affair. The fingered acoustic bass sounds woody and dark while playing against the light cymbals and the vibrant electric piano and trumpet. The individual instruments have a slight battle for dominance, but the persistence of the slick styled bass ultimately wins.

incompetech.title: Faster Does It
incompetech.description: Fast-paced and frenetic, the acoustic bass plays in every register available to the instrument, while the drum kit is chaotic and harried. You know... Bebop.

incompetech.title: Hustle
incompetech.description: The bass guitar plays a familiar rolling Blues riff, while accompanied by organ, acoustic guitar, and drums. A toe-tapping beat plays throughout, and can be used as the background music for a fast-paced game or scene, or as the intro to a scene full of bustling people.

incompetech.title: Isolated
incompetech.description: Intricate finger styling on a bass guitar creates a thematic melody full of solitude that drastically slows to a lethargic ending. This makes for a great transition piece for an outdoors scene or to depict isolation.

incompetech.title: Raw
incompetech.description: This low bass guitar piece is dirty ad raw; the strings are forcefully played, and you can hear the vibrations, the squeaks, and the ruggedness, all of which creates a carefree attitude. The drums are barely noticeable. The other bass accompanies the root bass without ever gaining prominence. When the drums stop and the bass plays its final refrain, you can really hear how the music is refreshingly unrefined.

incompetech.title: Silly Fun
incompetech.description: This is a set of 2 happy bubble-gummy themes for a comic platformer-type video game. Also included in the mp3 file are three different endings - quick, longer, and other.

incompetech.title: Bump in the Night
incompetech.description: Haunting noises and a tribal drum permeate this eclectic soundscape, and just before the first minute is up demonic breathy noises give way to a chilling silence before the return of the pounding drum. Caution: Very bass heavy.

incompetech.title: Vanes
incompetech.description: A disturbingly sweet melody on an electric piano is accompanied with a slow and steady beat. Synth sounds undulate in the background, fighting for prominence. They ultimately melt away, leaving the piano melody to play one last despair-filled refrain.

incompetech.title: Gymnopedie No. 1
incompetech.description: Elegant and slightly dark, the simplicity of the piano melody is light and touching, with a feeling of pensive restraint. It is beautiful accompaniment to the close of a drama, or of a midday reverie. Composed by Erik Satie.

incompetech.title: Gymnopedie No. 2
incompetech.description: This piece is dramatic and very dynamic; in the beginning and towards the end the music is soft and tender, but it is punctuated by aggressive changes in volume and minor chords throughout. This piece could work well to depict grief, as the emotions and feelings are similarly mercurial. Composed by Erik Satie.

incompetech.title: Gymnopedie No. 3
incompetech.description: A slow waltz with a beautiful and haunting melody played mostly in the higher registers. A few notes were added to Satie?s composition to keep things interesting and give the music a more full sound, the music ends with a very dark chord. This music is sad and tragic, and could be used as accompaniment to a slow dance or an art house film. Composed by Erik Satie.

incompetech.title: Darkest Child var A
incompetech.description: A notably quicker version of "Darkest Child".

incompetech.title: Darkest Child
incompetech.description: A childlike celeste plays high notes among a barely audible harp and deep bass. In the second minute the disturbing melody is in a lower register, and strings accentuate the discordant sounds before returning to the high register. The music is excellent for a creepy dream sequence or the exposition of an unknown fantasy world. SMARTSOUND

incompetech.title: Enter the Maze
incompetech.description: A thumping bass note intermingles with metallic noises to create a feeling of tension and terror. Screeching synth noises enter occasionally, and after a shrill screaming lead, the percussion is sparse but nerve-racking.

incompetech.title: Scissors
incompetech.description: Subtle atmospheric sounds and rain-like cymbal elements blend together, creating an aura of intensity and intrigue, suitable for a mysterious or suspenseful production. The sounds build in force just before the end.

incompetech.title: Grim League
incompetech.description: This all drum ensemble will convey the gravity of the situation; Funeral, speech about a battle plan, the importance of tungsten. Anything with weight.

incompetech.title: Movement Proposition
incompetech.feel: Action, Aggressive, Driving, Epic, Grooving, Intense
incompetech.description: Fight scenes and chase scenes. Also good for high energy magic shows.

incompetech.title: Relent
incompetech.description: Sadness... so much sadness. Plaintiveness maybe? Anyhoo, very down.

incompetech.title: Scattershot
incompetech.description: Fast tempo and loose timing gives this piece some not-quite-in-control speed.

incompetech.title: Constancy Part One
incompetech.instruments: Strings, Chimes, Glockenspiel, Bassoon, Bass Clarinet
incompetech.description: A rapid piece full of alternating strings and bassoons, with long and drastic bass notes. The heavy funereal chimes and foreboding minor key evoke a scene of a frantic chase through the woods or a race against time.

incompetech.title: Constancy Part Three
incompetech.description: Beautiful sweeping strings run counter to an energetic wind section with light accents from the glock's piercing bell tones.

incompetech.title: Constancy Part Two
incompetech.instruments: Strings, Chimes, Timpani, Flute, Bass Clarinet, Bassoon, Oboe
incompetech.description: Full of rhythmic strings and woodwinds in the lower registers, the high pitched violin that edges in and out of tune is unnerving and eerie. The pounding bass drums and church bells ring throughout, a symbol of impending doom. This music draws the line between being beautiful and frighteningly dystopian.

incompetech.title: Sneaky Snitch
incompetech.description: An oboe and a snare drum dance a tantalizing number with the whimsical plucks of a string quartet. The staccato nature of the music suggests walking on tiptoes, while the nasal notes of the oboe flits about almost imperceptibly. In the final minute, the string quartet plays a simple rhythm, before the oboe and snare drum crescendo to the finale.

incompetech.title: At The Shore
incompetech.description: A mixture of African vocal chants and Caribbean-styled percussion and bass guitar makes you long for your hammock. The piece is relaxing and gets you in the mood for ?Island Time? - where the troubles of the world melt away in the ocean breeze.

incompetech.title: Circus Tent
incompetech.instruments: Trumpets, Trombones, Horns, Drum Kit, Percussion
incompetech.description: With a bouncing bass and frantic trumpet blasts, the cymbals crash and instantly take you inside the circus tent, where a tense high-wire act competes with the rotund ringmaster. The music is jovial and intense, with a flair of ridiculousness.

incompetech.title: Fluffing a Duck
incompetech.instruments: Tuba, Flute, Trombones, Bass Clarinet, Clarinet, Percussion
incompetech.description: A trombone plays a humorous melody alongside timpanis and a variety of woodwind instruments. This music is suited for a short theme for a comedic piece that relies on visual jokes.  2 Small versions in one file.

incompetech.title: Private Eye
incompetech.description: Styled in the bluesy swing of a 70?s cop drama TV show, Private Eye incorporates slick rhythms with a prominent bass line and competing bursts of horns. The final thirty seconds builds in volume with the congas until the abrupt finish.

incompetech.title: The Forest and the Trees
incompetech.description: A peaceful exploration of the interplay between woodwinds weaving through a melody, underscored by soft brass chords. The music evokes scenes of nature, acceptance, and quietude.

incompetech.title: Autumn Day
incompetech.instruments: Guitar, Bass, Drum Kit, Strings, Piano, Choir
incompetech.description: A reflective piece with piano, guitar, simplified percussion, and subtle strings, this music is calm and comforting, like a good book and a hot cup of tea. The chord progressions are interesting and repeat often, which gives the piece a memorable quality.

incompetech.title: Itty Bitty 8 Bit
incompetech.description: Playful and interesting, Itty Bitty 8-Bit immediately introduces you to a pulsating melody flitting above a synthesized bass. The melody changes in the second minute and builds while climbing the chromatic scale, before settling back into the familiar refrain. This could be looped for a classic-styled videogame that is quirky and imaginative.

incompetech.title: Aces High
incompetech.description: Like a night out on the Vegas strip, Aces High makes your hips swagger with a playful bass line and staccato electric guitar. An organ plays the main theme, but when the song changes to a minor key, a clavichord plucks out the central melody, before returning to the slippery organ refrain.

incompetech.title: Not As It Seems
incompetech.description: A quizzical harp and bell introduction transports you to a mysterious land of magic as bouncing horns and pounding bass drums signify peril. In the last twenty seconds an orchestra takes over and the intensity rises, leaving the scene in danger?s hands.

incompetech.title: Organic Meditations One
incompetech.description: Very long, very calming piece in D Flat major. Part one of a series of three.

incompetech.title: Organic Meditations Three
incompetech.description: Very long, very calming piece in D Flat major. Part two of a series of three.

incompetech.title: Organic Meditations Two
incompetech.description: Very long, very calming piece in D Flat major. Part two of a series of three.

incompetech.title: Windswept
incompetech.description: A relaxed guitar and strings piece for the denouement of a story or exposition of the scenic outdoors. The guitar is peaceful as the strings gently build in prominence. The tempo is regular overall, but slows down in key moments to build a sense of tranquility.

incompetech.title: Decisions
incompetech.description: A vocal chorus blends with subtle percussion and panning synth effects that rattles the bones. The choir rises in volume almost imperceptibly before dissolving, leaving a sense of drama and consequence. Perfect for the background music to build suspense and intrigue. Loopable.

incompetech.title: Honey Bee
incompetech.description: The electric piano alternates between playing the rhythm and creating a sliding melody, while trumpets sound in the background, sometimes stealing the melody. The percussion makes for a toe-tapping good time. This is useful for the closing segment of a TV show, game, or transition. Cleanly loopable.

incompetech.title: Rising
incompetech.description: Heavy on the percussion, this piece is dominated by the rising strings in the second minute, which quickly give way to an ethereal alto chorus. The accompaniment rises together before dissipating. Loopable.

incompetech.title: There It Is
incompetech.description: Very quick and jovial, this brass heavy piece has a guitar riff that sticks in the brain, but ends suddenly. Useful for a quick theme introduction, transition, or for a fast and exciting commercial.

incompetech.title: Gone Beyond
incompetech.description: The child-like music box is the constant in this piece, but the repetition of the melody shifts from innocence to the music of a character detached from life, on the verge of psychoses or paranoia. The choir in the background lends the music a heavenly, albeit sepulchral feel.

incompetech.title: Show Your Moves
incompetech.description: Your toe will start tapping to the bump of the bass drum once the music pans through your speakers.  This song is one for a successful accomplishment or the happy ending to a difficult challenge.  The staccato melody resembles a synthesized tremolo violin, while the bass guitar thumps increase  in prominence until they are your heartbeat.

incompetech.title: Sneaky
incompetech.description: Ascending and descending chromatic scales gives this piece an air of mischief; perfectly suited for a cartoon. It has moments of tenuous fluidity, rapid motion, and a touch of suspense, making it perfect for the classic scene where the hero is sneaking past the sleeping giant.

incompetech.title: At Rest
incompetech.description: A recurring voice melody cascades over piano chords that sway in the breeze. Strings and horns then play the melody as the piano is slightly more forceful before settling again. It is suggestive of sadness, but with a sense of closure and peace.

incompetech.title: Dark Times
incompetech.description: Deeply troubling and somber, this piece is heavy on the bass strings, especially in the last minute. The feel is very dark and funereal, and could be used to depict the beginning of the apocalypse.

incompetech.title: In The West
incompetech.description: The percussion and strings start off bright, but deceive you as they turn to a powerful minor key. The string bass plays a prominent role, interacting with and leading the treble to the sudden conclusion.

incompetech.title: Procession of the King
incompetech.description: A strings only piece, evocative of love, romance, and pride. Just before the one minute mark the music takes an unexpected turn, becoming intensely emotional and beautiful as the strings play in the higher register with a slight tremolo, with the bass filling up the empty space in the last half minute.

incompetech.title: The Other Side of the Door
incompetech.filename: The Other Side of the Door.mp3
incompetech.description: A quick and off-color melody on the harp transports you to a mystical eerie world, while a flute plays a sweet melody, and pizzicato strings create a playful undertone. Quite a bit happens in this piece musically, it can be used to complement scenes of mischief, an eerie scene, or a world of magic and intrigue.

incompetech.title: Cattails
incompetech.description: An acoustic guitar and a banjo create a drifting lull as an accordion and erhu play a languid melody. The accordion is slightly forceful, while the tremolo of the erhu is uncertain, creating an intertwined dialogue of two vastly different characters. The piece is calm and pensive, with subtle notes of East Asian and Country Western influences.

incompetech.title: Pinball Spring 160
incompetech.description: Triumphant and exuberant, this arcade groove is bright and perfect for retro games or humorous video content. Super fast J-Pop feel version.

incompetech.title: Pinball Spring
incompetech.description: Triumphant and exuberant, this arcade groove is bright and perfect for retro games or humorous video content. It has a thumping beat that is light-hearted, and is easily looped for continuous play.

incompetech.title: Tafi Maradi no voice
incompetech.description: Percussion beats and shakers instantly make your feet tap, involving you in the tribal experience of ritual kinship. Three sets of call-and-response chanting slide into the forefront of the beat, interspersed with rapid djembe solos to the ending when the dust finally settles.

incompetech.title: Tafi Maradi
incompetech.description: Percussion beats and shakers instantly make your feet tap, involving you in the tribal experience of ritual kinship. Three sets of call-and-response chanting slide into the forefront of the beat, interspersed with rapid djembe solos to the ending when the dust finally settles.

incompetech.title: Amazing Plan - Distressed
incompetech.description: With elements of a quick Russian polka playing in the immigrant section of industrial-era New York City, this piece is mainly in a minor key, but at the halfway point changes to a major key, reversing the feel and tone for a few seconds, before reverting to the darkness of the minor key.

incompetech.title: Amazing Plan
incompetech.description: With elements of a quick Russian polka playing in the immigrant section of industrial-era New York City, this piece is mainly in a minor key, but at the halfway point changes to a major key, reversing the feel and tone for a few seconds, before reverting to the darkness of the minor key.

incompetech.title: Iron Horse - Distressed
incompetech.description: Darkly plodding, this staccato piano piece is the tense setting for the classic silent film scene: the heroine is tied to the train tracks, the steam engine train plugging along towards her. The chug-a-chug feel is maintained by a tense hammering of the chords in triplets, depicting machinery or chaos set in motion without an end in sight.

incompetech.title: Iron Horse
incompetech.description: Darkly plodding, this staccato piano piece is the tense setting for the classic silent film scene: the heroine is tied to the train tracks, the steam engine train plugging along towards her. The chug-a-chug feel is maintained by a tense hammering of the chords in triplets, depicting machinery or chaos set in motion without an end in sight.

incompetech.title: Merry Go - Distressed
incompetech.description: Comedic and playful, this rag-time ditty has a strong melody, and is heavy in the bass chords. The second minute features flighty finger-work, as if an energetic bee is flying up and down the scales. The last thirty seconds is a refrain of the introduction, and the piece ends with an invigorating flourish.

incompetech.title: Merry Go Slower - Distressed
incompetech.description: Comedic and playful, this rag-time ditty has a strong melody, and is heavy in the bass chords. The second minute features flighty finger-work, as if an energetic bee is flying up and down the scales. The last thirty seconds is a refrain of the introduction, and the piece ends with an invigorating flourish.

incompetech.title: Merry Go Slower
incompetech.description: Comedic and playful, this rag-time ditty has a strong melody, and is heavy in the bass chords. The second minute features flighty finger-work, as if an energetic bee is flying up and down the scales. The last thirty seconds is a refrain of the introduction, and the piece ends with an invigorating flourish.

incompetech.title: Merry Go
incompetech.description: Comedic and playful, this rag-time ditty has a strong melody, and is heavy in the bass chords. The second minute features flighty finger-work, as if an energetic bee is flying up and down the scales. The last thirty seconds is a refrain of the introduction, and the piece ends with an invigorating flourish.

incompetech.title: Villainous Treachery - Distressed
incompetech.description: The melody for this piece is in the bass keys, while the high notes play a headache-splitting constant rhythm. At the one-minute mark the high-pitched notes drop several octaves to play a crunched staccato before returning to the previous theme. The last thirty seconds feature drawn out chords, and the tempo slows dramatically, ending with frustrated trills in both registers, signaling the demise of the villain.

incompetech.title: Villainous Treachery
incompetech.description: The melody for this piece is in the bass keys, while the high notes play a headache-splitting constant rhythm. At the one-minute mark the high-pitched notes drop several octaves to play a crunched staccato before returning to the previous theme. The last thirty seconds feature drawn out chords, and the tempo slows dramatically, ending with frustrated trills in both registers, signaling the demise of the villain.

incompetech.title: Court of the Queen
incompetech.description: Slow Waltz. English Waltz. Foxtrot. Slow Fox. Regal in its construction, this waltz is meant for the ballroom floor of a grand soiree. The pizzicato strings provide the rhythm in the first half, while strings and horns play the melody. A harp accompanies a celeste in creating transitions between segments of the music. As the music crescendos into the third minute, the frivolity turns more serious, and the piece ends with a few interchangeable chords between the celeste and the horns.

incompetech.title: Evil March
incompetech.description: Description pending.

incompetech.title: Failing Defense
incompetech.description: This piece begins immediately with horn blasts, strings, and a bone-jangling xylophone. After the brief intro the horns play a melody, then the horns drop away away except tribal drums and staccato string bursts. The music returns in a big way, suggestive of a tense battle, as the instruments compete against each other, until the rapid discordant end.

incompetech.title: Old Road
incompetech.description: This music is the introduction to your characters entering a Middle Eastern village for the first time. The tribal drumming is all hustle and bustle, while the melody is winding, forceful, and unfamiliar.

incompetech.title: Pop Goes the Weasel
incompetech.description: Heavy bass drums and an string bass set the tone for this dark and menacing tone. The familiar refrain then plays, but is made expressive and almost violent as it is played on several string basses and cellos. The pace is rather quick and forceful, and after the quick ending, a jack-in-the-box plays, normally child-like, but made creepy because of the sinister music that came before.

incompetech.title: Rains Will Fall
incompetech.description: Slow Waltz. English Waltz. Foxtrot. Slow Fox. The piano plays a mournful, waltzing melody, while strings enter gently. Halfway into the second minute, the tone is more hopeful, but then returns to the sadness of the introduction.  Just before the third minute ends the hope returns, but melts again into sadness with the final high note of the piano. This is music for a rainy day, or when the hero to a story has lost his way.

incompetech.title: Rites
incompetech.description: Heavy and deep, the chords of this piece resemble Gregorian Chanting with resounding reverb as a harp plucks a few solitary notes. The music evokes an ancient ritual or ceremony, but could also be used for a tragic medieval funeral.

incompetech.title: Spazzmatica Polka
incompetech.description: Boisterous and nearly obnoxious, this piece will lodge itself in your brain and make you think you?re trapped in an arcade. The polka rhythm is quick and the melody is spastic. Right into the second minute the rhythm drops out and introduces a crazed, comedic melody that continues throughout until the abrupt end.

incompetech.title: Thatched Villagers
incompetech.description: Solid in pace, The Thatched Roof Villagers moves with percussion and a number of flutes and pipes struggling for dominance. The real joy of the piece is halfway through when the tinny dulcimer plays the melody and is then joined by the flutes in melody and harmony. The music is jovial and inviting. Loopable.

incompetech.title: Eastminster
incompetech.description: The constant reverberating sound of rain and the perfect-fifth drone of the strings are calming, but have an air of suspense and tension about them, as if a drama is about to unfold. The koto plays a near continuous refrain, at times forcefully. Evoking pre-colonialist East Asia, the piece is beautiful and stoic in tone, especially as the koto asserts its dominance in the sixth minute and at the end.

incompetech.title: Silver Blue Light
incompetech.description: Sparse in it?s instrumentation, Silver Blue Light is quiet and pensive with atmospheric synthesized chords and guitar.. There isn?t much of a melodic line to this piece until well into the fifth minute. In the third minute the guitar plays a few high notes, and the key changes briefly, which occurs again in the final twenty seconds as well.

incompetech.title: When The Wind Blows
incompetech.description: Several wind instruments play lilting melodies that are slow and meander through the piece, sometimes bordering on being slightly out of tune. The calm music has an edge of solemnity about it. The ever-present acoustic guitar is methodical and resembles a pulse ? it exists but is forgotten, except when the guitar draws out the length of a note.

incompetech.title: Porch Swing Days - faster
incompetech.instruments: Guitars, Bass, Drum Kit, Percussion, Voice
incompetech.description: Acoustic guitars play a constantly flowing feel-good melody, enhanced by an airy chorus that enters early in the piece. The music is bright and evokes a carefree attitude towards life and the troubles of the world.

incompetech.title: Porch Swing Days - slower
incompetech.instruments: Guitars, Bass, Drum Kit, Percussion, Voice
incompetech.description: Acoustic guitars play a constantly flowing feel-good melody, enhanced by an airy chorus that enters early in the piece. The music is bright and evokes a carefree attitude towards life and the troubles of the world.

incompetech.title: Redletter
incompetech.description: High-pitched strings play above a low drone, while fuzzy noises and cymbal rolls flow throughout. The high strings crescendo and quickly cut out as if a knife sliced their throats.  A somber melody plays in the final minute, and the noises crescendo and come at you from every angle, symbolic of an attack and a gruesome finale.

incompetech.title: Right Behind You
incompetech.description: Breathy noises make the hairs on the back of your neck stand, while screeching strings and high-pitched noises are distracting and spine-tingling.

incompetech.title: Sweeter Vermouth
incompetech.instruments: Tenor Sax, Alto Sax, Trumpets, Vibraphone, Trombones, Drum Kit
incompetech.description: The jaunty bass line keeps this short piece moving at a solid pace, while the vibraphone and saxophones play the swinging melody, until the bright, thump of an ending. Use this piece as a slick transition between scenes or for the background to a short scene of drinking, gambling, or dancing.

incompetech.title: The Hive
incompetech.description: Cymbals and synthesizers evoke swarming insects, as whirring and clicking noises abound with heavy reverb.

incompetech.title: The House of Leaves
incompetech.description: A simple harp refrain plays a child?s melody, but is torn apart by discordant screeching noises, thumps, growls, and mechanical noises.

incompetech.title: Whiskey on the Mississippi
incompetech.instruments: Guitar, Bass, Drum Kit, Organ, Electric Piano
incompetech.description: With a jumping bass and off-beat syncopation, this is straight from Memphis? Beale Street. The Hammond organ and electric guitar play together as longtime friends, while the melody changes hands from guitar to organ to electric piano.

incompetech.title: Finding the Balance
incompetech.description: The beginning is calm with the Middle Eastern dudek playing the melody. As the electronic elements melt into the dudek and the plucked strings, the groove is established.  Just into the third minute the melody changes to beautiful and touching, but returns to the feel of the intro, while a woman?s voice sings a haunting melody in a distant language. This is music of wonder, and is best as exposition music for a film about nature or a group of people struggling to survive.

incompetech.title: Grammophone Taps
incompetech.description: Warning - this is played wrong...

incompetech.title: Ibn Al-Noor
incompetech.description: Evocative of the Arab world, the music begins stoically; the melody accentuated by simple percussive sounds. Within the first minute, the strings hypnotize with their sinuous melody, the tribal drumming awakening the senses. In the third minute the piece changes to a heavy, dangerous string and tribal drumming that builds until all of the instruments come together in a fitful way, until the abrupt ending.

incompetech.title: Clenched Teeth
incompetech.description: Timpanis and strings battle with a snare drum and horns throughout this epic piece, slowly building and rising to chaos. The music is high-action and only includes a few short dramatic interludes.

incompetech.title: For the Fallen
incompetech.description: Beginning with beautiful symphonic chords accentuated by a glockenspiel, For The Fallen builds gently and with emotion. At the mid-point, marching drums build in and the music strikes a more serious tone, retaining its dramatic passion.

incompetech.title: Split In Synapse
incompetech.description: A short piece that mixes the symphony with frenzied electronica elements and a dance beat. The horns are blasting and discordant, the synthesizer is manic, the effects disorienting, and the final cresecendo push is loud and forceful.

incompetech.title: Fig Leaf Rag - distressed
incompetech.description: The classic ragtime ditty of Scott Joplin, perfect for a silent film of whimsy and humor. The piece begins with a short intro, then plays the bouncy rhythm of with a bright plodding beat. At the end of the third minute, the pace quickens, and leads into a darker refrain, but the jolly melody returns for the finale.  With added record player effects.

incompetech.title: Fig Leaf Rag
incompetech.description: The classic ragtime ditty of Scott Joplin, perfect for a silent film of whimsy and humor. The piece begins with a short intro, then plays the bouncy rhythm of with a bright plodding beat. At the end of the third minute, the pace quickens, and leads into a darker refrain, but the jolly melody returns for the finale.

incompetech.title: For Originz
incompetech.description: Heavy strings play several chords before a violin enters with a sliding melody, in tandem with a woman?s voice and flute. The bass drums are barely perceptible, but accentuate the orchestra as the three melodic personalities float amongst the music. The music is full of wonder and power, and ends in a strong chord, evoking a connection with nature.

incompetech.title: Mistake the Getaway
incompetech.description: The chase begins with horn blasts, and the kit plays a solid beat while the bass strings are a pulsing drone below the horn melody. The piece grows more tense and emotional, the strings taking the lead and rise into a flowing intensity. Danger returns in full force as the music crescendos and return for one final push.

incompetech.title: Nerves
incompetech.feel: Action, Dark, Eerie, Epic, Intense, Suspenseful
incompetech.description: The first two minutes contain many changes and shifts in tone - all intense.  The final minute is a collection of all that came before, ending in a pulse-quickening finale. This is music for an action film, or a scene that begins with tremulous anxiety and ends in a big way.

incompetech.title: Orion 300XB
incompetech.description: Unintelligible alien transmissions punctuate the entirety of this piece, while simple, distracted chords create an atmosphere of unease and wonder -  beauty and discovery. The pace is quick, and the taiko drumming is foreboding and tribal, but the airy beauty of the chords is almost calming.

incompetech.title: Open Those Bright Eyes
incompetech.description: This piece is made up of three distinct variations on a melodic theme, and should be taken apart and used for transitions in a light-hearted short video. The first section begins with a bright, leading to the big push of the bombastic brass. The second section, beginning at 0:52, is the same melody, but only features the piano. This section is softer and lasts 20 seconds. The final section begins at 1:17, and ends with an excited flourish.

incompetech.title: Take the Lead
incompetech.description: This is a rough and hard-hitting piece, best used as background music to a stressful, strained scene, or tense and suspenseful content. Heavy distorted guitars begin the song, and at 0:41 the soaring synth leads play the melody while the powerful drums kick in.  A high-pitched pulsating synth effect carries the last seventeen seconds to the final punch.

incompetech.title: Devastation and Revenge
incompetech.feel: Eerie, Epic, Intense, Mystical, Somber, Suspenseful
incompetech.instruments: Synths, Percussion, Strings, Brass, Guitar, Voice
incompetech.description: A low hum sets a dark and mysterious mood, but at 0:49 the orchestral strings, horns, and pounding drums begin, perfect as the background to the hero?s dilemma or impending battle scene. At 2:01 the music reaches a climax and builds into discordant, terrifying suspense. The ending, at 2:35, features a lone guitar and mournful vocals, depicting a great sadness and loss.

incompetech.title: Finding Movement
incompetech.description: The koto in this piece follows a steady, plodding beat, while the orchestral strings provide a drone-like background. At 0:33 the strings crescendo to follow the melody of the koto, but at 1:18 the tempo slows and the strings fade away, only to return to highlight the final chord.  With the even rhythm and the sharply accentuated plucks of the koto, this is best used as an introduction to a short film or game, or the resolution to a conflict surrounding family or challenges to tradition.

incompetech.title: One-eyed Maestro
incompetech.instruments: Accordion, Violin, Percussion, Flutes, Trumpets, Horns, Strings
incompetech.description: This is the kind of music that makes skeletons dance. With its pounding brass, singsong flute melody, and off-kilter syncopation, this piece is whimsical and reminiscent of a carnival. It is quirky, quick, playful, and dangerously creepy, and is perfect for a lively cartoon, circus-themed content, or a magician?s show.

incompetech.title: Ripples
incompetech.description: Flowing like water, this serene piece is perfect for relaxation and meditation. The solitary plucks of the Chinese guzheng reverberate slightly, and maintain a steadiness that would work well for introspective, Asian-themed content. This would also work well for anything depicting snow, winter, or Rural Japan.

incompetech.title: Stealth Groover
incompetech.instruments: Piano, Bass, Guitar, Drum Kit, Synth
incompetech.description: The constancy of the bass melts into your consciousness, as the syncopation of the high-pitched piano and electric guitar keep the groove flowing. Subtle synthesizer arrangements change the flow of the song and keep it interesting, while the rhythm section is playful and experimental. This is perfect for a scene where the spy learns a new skill or performs an act of guile, or as the background to a low-key, tech-oriented game.

incompetech.title: Prelude in C (BWV 846)
incompetech.description: J. S. Bach. This is the famous first piece of the Well Tempered Clavier, Book 1. Performed on piano. Very clean recording.

incompetech.title: Song of the Volga Boatmen
incompetech.description: Yo, Heave Ho! The classic theme of difficult drudgery. Based on a Russian folk song.

incompetech.title: Chee Zee Beach
incompetech.description: Light and breezy loopable piece.

incompetech.title: Chee Zee Cave
incompetech.description: Loping dissonant loopable atmospheric.

incompetech.title: Chee Zee Jungle
incompetech.description: Where is this jungle? I have no idea. Videogameland, I suspect.

incompetech.title: Chee Zee Lab
incompetech.description: Semi-industrial loopable driving piece.

incompetech.title: Eastern Thought
incompetech.description: Moderately relaxed, moderately intense, very eastern.

incompetech.title: Consort for Brass
incompetech.description: A stately brass choir set in a cathedral.

incompetech.title: Nu Flute
incompetech.description: Eastern flute-like reed-like instrument - the Dizi.

incompetech.title: Agnus Dei X
incompetech.description: Just a quick piece from a traditional Latin mass. Lyrics are "Agnus Dei, qui tollis peccata mundi, miserere nobis._. Agnus Dei, qui tollis peccata mundi, dona nobis pacem". For Sopranos and Bass.

incompetech.title: New Direction
incompetech.description: A calm ambient piece using the "Trope" synth for iPhone and some miscellaneous Logic synths.

incompetech.title: Ranz des Vaches
incompetech.description: Ranz des Vaches or "Call to the Dairy Cows" is a small but famous section of the overture to William Tell by Rossini. It is most often used to depict morning or sleepiness in cartoons. Hook starts at 0:21.

incompetech.title: Robo-Western
incompetech.description: A smooth glitchy action piece with a guitar sound inspired by Morricone and a setting that is very contemporary.

incompetech.title: Second Coming - no percussion
incompetech.description: A loop-based piece, I've gotten a lot of requests for a version of this with no percussion or voice - so here you go. Broad and inspiring.

incompetech.title: Sinfonia Number 5
incompetech.description: J. S. Bach's 3-part invention that I hacked together for music for a "stuffy aristocratic dinner party". Of all the Sinfonias, I think this works the best for that.

incompetech.title: Space Fighter Loop
incompetech.description: Written as a background loop for a space fighting video game.

incompetech.title: Tenebrous Brothers Carnival - Mermaid
incompetech.feel: Eerie, Intense, Mysterious, Mystical, Relaxed, Suspenseful, Unnerving
incompetech.instruments: Harps, Voice, Exotic Organ, Waterphone, Percussion, Glass Harmonica
incompetech.description: Is she a mer-maid, or is she an illusion! Her enchanting voice will entice, and she is 100% alive! Keep your wits about you, gentlemen - you don't want to be dragged to an unfortunate end.  Very heavy on bass.

incompetech.title: Tenebrous Brothers Carnival - Snake Lady
incompetech.description: One of the more sultry sideshow acts in the Tenebrous Brothers Carnival, The Snake Lady is a crowd favorite that most never forget, even if they don't remember exactly what happened during the show.

incompetech.title: Zap Beat
incompetech.instruments: Guitar, Bass, Drum Kit, Synths, Organ
incompetech.description: Perfectly loopable for background applications that need a little bit of drive that doesn't annoy.

incompetech.title: Ghostpocalypse - 1 Departure
incompetech.description: 1 of 8 in Ghostpocalypse. 100% atmospheric. No melodic or rhythmic elements.

incompetech.title: Ghostpocalypse - 2 The Call
incompetech.description: 2 of 8. Some dark and low rhythmic elements. Some bits of piano.

incompetech.title: Ghostpocalypse - 3 Road of Trials
incompetech.description: 3 of 8. Odd phrasing and counterpoints.

incompetech.title: Ghostpocalypse - 4 Temptress
incompetech.description: 4 of 8. Driving slower rhythm with piano.

incompetech.title: Ghostpocalypse - 5 Apotheosis
incompetech.description: 5 of 8. Feverish build near the midway point.

incompetech.title: Ghostpocalypse - 6 Crossing the Threshold
incompetech.description: 6 of 8. Waltz-like theme.

incompetech.title: Ghostpocalypse - 7 Master
incompetech.description: 7 of 8. This is the giant percussive piece of the series. Break in the middle, resumes fast to the end.

incompetech.title: Ghostpocalypse - 8 Epilog
incompetech.description: 8 of 8. Quirky little solo for 2 pianos and one player.

incompetech.title: A Singular Perversion
incompetech.description: Overplayed piano, subtle percussion, sweepy violins.

incompetech.title: Dopplerette
incompetech.description: Swift, abrupt ending.

incompetech.title: Final Count
incompetech.feel: Action, Dark, Epic, Intense, Somber, Unnerving
incompetech.instruments: Percussion, Piano, Choir, Orchestra, Pipe Organ
incompetech.description: Epic piece taking off from Chopin's famous funeral march (Piano Sonata #2). Death! Death! Death!

incompetech.title: Habanera
incompetech.instruments: Solo Female Voice, Clarinet, Strings, Brass, Percussion
incompetech.description: The famous Habanera aria from Georges Bizet's opera "Carmen". Sung by Jenny Lee Mitchell.

incompetech.title: Lightless Dawn
incompetech.feel: Dark, Eerie, Mysterious, Mystical, Somber, Unnerving
incompetech.description: Add a dark intensity to any scene... Is there building action? Is there a clue? Is there a need for ambiguity?

incompetech.title: Seventh Seal
incompetech.description: Simple drone followed by a crescendo leading to silence.

incompetech.title: Spacial Harvest
incompetech.description: Deep unsettling piece with no repeated themes. Fat, rounded bass drone with very high pitched interest on top.

incompetech.title: Spring Thaw
incompetech.description: Simple melody. Something feels amiss here, but in a sort of pleasing way

incompetech.title: Sunset at Glengorm
incompetech.description: Processed piano is featured, leaving a deep uncertain texture. Tempo is highly variable.

incompetech.title: World Vice
incompetech.description: Piece in three parts (appx 1 minute each), all up-tempo. Written for a juggling competition.

incompetech.title: Happy Boy End Theme
incompetech.description: Happy bouncy theme for a comic hero! Written for Craig Knitt's short "Happy Boy". This track has themes in 2 variations in 2 tempos.

incompetech.title: Happy Boy Theme
incompetech.description: Happy bouncy theme for a comic hero! Written for Craig Knitt's short "Happy Boy".

incompetech.title: Investigations
incompetech.instruments: Pizzicato Strings, English Horn, Bassoon, Marimba, Glockenspiel, Cowbells
incompetech.description: Sort of a loafing comedic piece for all of your amusing scenes with dialog that does not need to move the story. Also reasonable for scenes with no dialog.

incompetech.title: Resignation
incompetech.description: Short piece with a very quiet and rich piano part - the bass is barely audible, for low-end support.

incompetech.title: Sneaky Adventure
incompetech.description: Tight pizz string section, joined by a lone bassoon on the recapitulation.

incompetech.title: Tenebrous Brothers Carnival - Act One
incompetech.instruments: Organ, Percussion, Glockenspiel, Voice, Clarinet, Strings, Tuba
incompetech.description: This peculiar piece does have a story. If anyone would like to animate it, you'll have to bring your own script. Moderately large changes every minute or so. Accelerando at the end.

incompetech.title: Tenebrous Brothers Carnival - Act Three
incompetech.description: Metallic and generally unpleasant... yet I like this piece quite a bit. It gives the impression of a giant mechanical automaton.

incompetech.title: Tenebrous Brothers Carnival - Act Two
incompetech.description: A fast deep unyielding sort of waltz-like-thing.

incompetech.title: Tenebrous Brothers Carnival - Intermission
incompetech.description: Grooves for a bit, then changes up pretty hard with giant percussion.

incompetech.title: Tenebrous Brothers Carnival - Prelude
incompetech.description: Originally released in a special collection as "Delayed Due to Dissonance", this piece is not part of a larger arc.

incompetech.title: The Parting
incompetech.instruments: Oboe, Flute, Strings, Trombones, Horn, Tuba
incompetech.description: I wrote this one December 27th, 2009 mainly for fun. It is a sweeping quiet piece until the past bit where is opens up a bit.  At 2:06, there is an oddly supported line with a 2+ octave gap between the melody and the supporting bass. At 2:28, the gap is filled triumphantly... It ends with a hollow dominant in 5 octaves, followed by a lush resolution.

incompetech.title: Thinking of You
incompetech.description: Nice piece for a narrative voice-over of good times past, present or future.

incompetech.title: Umbrella Pants
incompetech.description: If naming tracks is so easy, you try it! Possibly sneaking, possibly comedic dialog, possibly comedic dialog while sneaking... 1,

incompetech.title: Harlequin
incompetech.description: Quirky little duet. Major contrast between a staccato piano line, and the sweeping long bass clarinet.

incompetech.title: Hypnothis
incompetech.description: Sweet chill electronic piece with a run of dissonances starting around 3 minutes in.

incompetech.title: Shores of Avalon
incompetech.description: Highly processed piano with lots of subtle synths and vocal effects. Grows in intensity after the 3 minute mark, then calms again.

incompetech.title: Alchemists Tower
incompetech.description: A crazy ride, starting calm and erupting into a frenzy. Calm again at the end. Very Elfman-like.

incompetech.title: MTA
incompetech.description: Urban-sounding tight piece suitable for rap or stand-alone. Some giant hits, and a cool B section in here. Mix consultant: Bryan Teoh.

incompetech.title: Ambiment
incompetech.description: Slow sonorous texture punctuated with soft piano in mostly consonant tones. There is enough dissonance to keep the mind engaged over its length.

incompetech.title: Noise Attack
incompetech.description: Dark driving rock thing. Heavy on the drums... actually, heavy on the everything.

incompetech.title: Sunshine (version 2)
incompetech.description: Slightly longer, slightly slower version of "Sunshine"

incompetech.title: What You Want (version 2)
incompetech.description: Same as the other version, but with no intelligible vocals.

incompetech.title: Clear Air
incompetech.description: Very easy-going piece for acoustic steel string guitar and classical guitar. Second A section includes deep and soft piano.

incompetech.title: Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy
incompetech.filename: Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy.mp3
incompetech.description: Tchaikovsky's piece, amped up a little bit and slightly arranged for more punch and bass.

incompetech.title: Sugar Plum Breakdown
incompetech.description: Just the final part of Tchaikovsky's piece with giant percussion and synths.

incompetech.title: Sugar Plum Dark Mix
incompetech.description: Tchaikovsky's dance  from the Nutcracker with lots of percussion and extra choirs.

incompetech.title: Impact Allegretto
incompetech.description: Track 5 of 6. Percussion starts on the offbeat. Large shift at 34 seconds, building to another at 42 seconds. Additional shift to mostly percussion at 1:52. Good pacing contours.

incompetech.title: Impact Andante
incompetech.description: 2 of 6. This piece changes perspectives a few times, and stays very fresh throughout.

incompetech.title: Impact Intermezzo
incompetech.description: 4 of 6. Zero melody, all percussion piece... might be useful for anything that needs a bit of urgency, but not too much.

incompetech.title: Impact Lento
incompetech.description: 6 of 6. Very slow start. This piece uses warm but thin textures, and several striking chord progressions.

incompetech.title: Impact Moderato
incompetech.description: 3 of 6. Laid back drum kit with a lot of extra percussion under a simple guitar.

incompetech.title: Impact Prelude
incompetech.description: 1 of 6. Chill opening theme with lots of percussion bits.

incompetech.title: Mind Scrape
incompetech.description: Interesting collection of consonant and dissonant sounds across the spectrum of sound.

incompetech.title: Neo Western
incompetech.description: Big drums and an exposed 'western-style' electric guitar. Lots of drums.

incompetech.title: Tranquility Base
incompetech.description: Super chill, meditative, and massively long drone. The preview is cut to three minutes, but the entire download is 18 minutes, and more than 42 meg. Please be patient.

incompetech.title: Beach Party
incompetech.instruments: Steel Drums, Guitar, Bass, Drum Kit, Organ
incompetech.description: Laid back day on an island beach.This piece of music is

incompetech.title: Der Kleber Sting
incompetech.description: Your standard "dun dun DUUUUN!" hit.

incompetech.title: Last Kiss Goodnight
incompetech.instruments: Guitar, Bass, Drum Kit, Strings, Piano
incompetech.description: Classic 50's/60's I, iv, IV, V chord progression as in "Unchained Melody" or "Sleepwalk".

incompetech.title: Nile's Blues
incompetech.description: Slow blues in 6/8. Tasty.

incompetech.title: Slow Burn
incompetech.description: Super nice progressive rock/blues piece with 3 sections.

incompetech.title: What You Want
incompetech.description: Super aggressive distorted piece with vocal effects.

incompetech.title: Lamentation
incompetech.description: Slow solo harp piece.

incompetech.title: Padanaya Blokov
incompetech.description: Catchy Russian-sounding piece.

incompetech.title: Petulant March
incompetech.description: Fun little impromptu in one take with lots of odd delay effects that give it a more lush feel.

incompetech.title: Symbiosis
incompetech.description: Quiet solo piano in 3 parts with additional percussion bit adding in more and more to the end. My normal "feels" that are used to classify pieces are largely inadequate for this piece, as are the genres. In other words... I have no idea what this is.

incompetech.title: Unpromised
incompetech.description: Thin piece with surprising chordal structures in the second A section.

incompetech.title: Disco Lounge
incompetech.description: Umm... this is really hard to describe. Take a listen, you might need it. Easy chill disco. It has an "eye of the tiger"-ish synth line and a super cool vibe part. Drum kit is distressed in parts.

incompetech.title: Kool Kats
incompetech.description: A sort of simple lounge chill spy piece.

incompetech.title: Birch Run
incompetech.description: Native American drumming, sometimes with rattles. The 2 main drummers are funkier than most Native American pieces.

incompetech.title: Black Bird
incompetech.description: Native American drumming with clapping to the feeling of bird wings.

incompetech.title: Firesong
incompetech.description: Native American drumming with a deep dark drive. Slowly picks up in speed throughout.

incompetech.title: Night of the Owl
incompetech.description: Native American drumming with a flute.

incompetech.title: Thunderhead
incompetech.description: Native American drumming. The branch rattle is reminiscent of thunder. Tempo picks up about halfway through.

incompetech.title: Dances and Dames
incompetech.instruments: Bass, Drum Kit, Electric Piano, Voice
incompetech.description: Off-center feeling film noir-like piece with a continually changing time signature. "Something is amiss on the streets. My job is to figure that out."

incompetech.title: Living Voyage
incompetech.description: Earthy and yet urban with a mix of personal and epic. This is a hybrid in all senses. Major uplift at 40 seconds in. Drops back down for another feel at 1:10.

incompetech.title: Rising Game
incompetech.feel: Dark, Driving, Epic, Grooving, Intense, Mysterious
incompetech.instruments: Bass, Brass, Percussion, Choir, Guitar, Strings, Pipe Organ
incompetech.description: Dark piece in 2 roughly equal main parts. Gets progressively more exciting.

incompetech.title: Truth of the Legend
incompetech.description: Solo voice along with a small choir and giant percussion section. Ends in a sort of ethereal mode.

incompetech.title: Willow and the Light
incompetech.description: Think dark overgrown forest with overtones of magic in it. This one can loop perfectly - if you cut it right.

incompetech.title: Fast Talkin
incompetech.description: Noir. Private detective from the 1940's sort of feel.

incompetech.title: Long Road Ahead B
incompetech.description: Same as "Long Road Ahead", but without the final triumphant section.

incompetech.title: Long Road Ahead
incompetech.description: Very simple folk melody. Like the aftermath of a battle between good and evil. Major triumphant section for the final third of the piece.

incompetech.title: Private Reflection
incompetech.feel: Dark, Eerie, Epic, Intense, Somber, Unnerving
incompetech.description: Epic myth. Part of the hero's journey. Starts with a solo soprano, and later mixes a full choir. Ends assuming you'll mix it into another piece.

incompetech.title: Wounded
incompetech.description: It is rain outside the window on the day of your husband's funeral. maybe not exactly that... but there's death involved somehow.

incompetech.title: Cambodian Odyssey
incompetech.description: Written on spec for a Cambodian documentary. The double-reed horn in the piece is actually a highly processed oboe changed to give an edge.

incompetech.title: Darkness is Coming
incompetech.description: Quiet yet epic. This piece is an odd mix. Highly processed drum kit.

incompetech.title: Soporific
incompetech.description: A laid-back chill, and chilling piece.

incompetech.title: Tranquility
incompetech.description: A calming meditative piece rendered on 4 iPhones using the Balls, Bloom, Bebot, and Ocarina applications.

incompetech.title: Winter Reflections
incompetech.description: A calming piece rendered on 3 iPhones using the Bloom, Bebot, and Balls applications.

incompetech.title: Freddy's Menagerie
incompetech.description: Fast chaotic piece in 3 sections. Almost rock, almost African, almost soundtrack material - this is a very useful piece in many applications.

incompetech.title: Quinn's Song: A New Man
incompetech.description: This piece starts with piano, and ends with tymp. It uses a reharmonized theme taken from Chopin. One of 3 pieces with this theme.

incompetech.title: Quinn's Song: First Night
incompetech.description: This piece contains 2 themes, one in 7/4 time, and another borrowed from Chopin - and set among very disturbing chords.

incompetech.title: Quinn's Song: The Dance Begins
incompetech.description: This piece takes its main theme from Chopin, completely reharmonizes it, and gives it a different setting. One of three pieces with this theme.

incompetech.title: Aftermath
incompetech.description: This is a dark, almost inky feel - subtle, and texturally rich.

incompetech.title: Awkward Meeting
incompetech.feel: Dark, Eerie, Intense, Mysterious, Mystical, Suspenseful, Unnerving
incompetech.description: Simple piano theme drives this, but it sometimes buried under unnerving textures. 7/4 time, rubato.

incompetech.title: Ghost Dance
incompetech.description: 6/8 piece with piano intro that leads into a sparse orchestral, and ends with piano again.

incompetech.title: Swimmey Texture
incompetech.description: Highly processed piano and synths that provide a deep, contemplative texture.

incompetech.title: Chanter
incompetech.description: Interesting hybrid of at least 3 traditions. For being plodding - it keeps up the intensity to a surprising degree.

incompetech.title: Killing Time
incompetech.description: Super bright super tight electronic mix with a beat turn-around around 2 minutes in, followed by swirling synths.

incompetech.title: One of Them
incompetech.description: Calm opening with giant hit around 1:50 that calms down some and ends on grating tones.

incompetech.title: Rocket
incompetech.description: Euro-tech with some highly processed guitar lines and symphonic elements.

incompetech.title: Somewhere Sunny (ver 2)
incompetech.description: This is a longer version of the very popular "Somewhere Sunny". Simple, clean guitar duet.

incompetech.title: Blue Paint
incompetech.description: Calm piano solo centered around a repeating Ab motive.  20 seconds before end the motive expands slightly with an added harmony.

incompetech.title: Corncob
incompetech.description: Bouncy country tune featuring fast banjo picking and grooving shuffle on the drumset.

incompetech.title: Desert City
incompetech.description: Middle Eastern atmospheric, sort of chill. This piece is easy to loop.

incompetech.title: Home Base Groove
incompetech.description: Short loopable piece meant for a video game section.

incompetech.title: Ominous
incompetech.description: Uneven foreboding short cue, winds play opposite strings.

incompetech.title: Round Drums
incompetech.description: A collection of mostly large drums. Useful for action scenes.

incompetech.title: The North
incompetech.description: Loopable small composition reminiscent of North American traditional music.

incompetech.title: Danse Macabre - Big Hit 1
incompetech.description: A 2 note hit from a section change in Danse Macabre. It can be used as a very short ending sting.

incompetech.title: Danse Macabre - Big Hit 2
incompetech.description: Another 2-note hit from the interior of Danse Macabre.

incompetech.title: Danse Macabre - Busy Strings
incompetech.description: An interesting section of Danse Macabre from around measure 145. There is a particularly nice viola trill with ornament.

incompetech.title: Danse Macabre - Finale
incompetech.description: Just the finale from the "Danse Macabre". This is the highest energy portion of the piece in isolation.

incompetech.title: Danse Macabre - Light Dance
incompetech.description: A small section of Danse Macabre that features the basses, cellos, and violas each taking one beat out of the measure with a triplet. Light melody on the top.

incompetech.title: Danse Macabre - Low Strings Finale
incompetech.description: Just the low strings and brass from the finale of "Danse Macabre".

incompetech.title: Danse Macabre
incompetech.description: Written by Saint Saens in 1874. This is a quite well known and epic piece of music.

incompetech.title: Smoother Move
incompetech.description: Super rubato piano solo.

incompetech.title: News Theme
incompetech.description: Big, Bold, piece suitable for news themes or the like.  Starts off with a Horns, which then continue throughout.  Fades out quickly. The Whip (Extended Version)

incompetech.title: The Whip
incompetech.description: The shorter theme written for the opening of The Whip Podcast. Starts off quick with a short drum roll, then continues with guitar.  Guitar used throughout, ends with a fade out using Kit.  Bass in the background only.

incompetech.title: Dirt Rhodes
incompetech.description: A slow blues piece with prominent kit.  Actual Mark I Stage Piano used in this recording.  EP used throughout in the background.

incompetech.title: To the Ends
incompetech.instruments: Bassoon, Bass Clarinet, Oboe, Clarinet, Trombones, Violins, Basses
incompetech.description: Horns used in the background.  Main melodies carried by clarinet and strings.  Starts off bright, ends darker.

incompetech.title: With a Creation
incompetech.description: An experimental piece, designed to emulate a keyboardist with her robot.  The piano player likes to play with the EP in this piece.  Take a listen to get the full effect.  EP used heavily throughout the entire piece.  Build at 1:02, percussion picks up with heavy, fast beats.

incompetech.title: At Launch
incompetech.instruments: Brass, Marching Snare, Harmon Mute Trumpet, Strings, Orchestral Percussion, Flute
incompetech.description: An epic orchestral work featuring heavy brass and strings.  This piece takes the listener on a spirited journey through military might and hopeful adventure.

incompetech.title: Basement Floor
incompetech.instruments: Synth Keys, Synth Bass, Synth Percussion, Choir
incompetech.description: A heavy synth slap bass and processed percussion drive this suspenseful piece. The consistent groove is complemented by a chorus for several more dramatic moments. Heavy Phasing, delay and reverb.

incompetech.title: Comfortable Mystery 2
incompetech.description: Gentle electric piano chords and descending arpeggi are featured in this calming piece.

incompetech.title: Comfortable Mystery 3
incompetech.description: Gentle Electric Piano with a descending arpeggiated motive. The ending gradually slows.

incompetech.title: Comfortable Mystery 4
incompetech.description: Gentle Electric Piano featuring light chords and a descending arpeggiated motive.

incompetech.title: Dark Star
incompetech.description: Dark Star is a orchestral fanfare featuring a rising motive led by the brass and strings.  The piece builds gradually and finishes with a full orchestral climax.

incompetech.title: Divertimento K131
incompetech.description: This is an arrangement of Mozart's Divertimento (K131) for bells, harp, chimes and celeste.  It is light and bouncy, with an accelerando around 45 seconds in.  The work is played two times.

incompetech.title: Dreamy Flashback
incompetech.description: This piece features repetitive triplet arpeggi and a lydian scale to invoke a dreamy feel.  Staccato instruments add to the piece's mystery.  The pattern is a continuous loop between two arpeggiated chords.

incompetech.title: Frost Waltz (Alternate)
incompetech.description: This is alternate take of "Frost Waltz." It features arpeggiated bells and strings oscillating gently between minor chords.

incompetech.title: Greta Sting
incompetech.description: A somber orchestral sting with a gentle rising motion.

incompetech.title: Gustav Sting
incompetech.description: A grooving sting featuring percussion and low staccato strings.

incompetech.title: Smooth Move
incompetech.description: A Simple Bass Groove with High Hat and Snare behind it. The repeated bass line is good for dancing.

incompetech.title: Spider Eyes
incompetech.description: Spider Eyes is an eerie soundscape created with distant high strings, dissonant non-percussive piano textures, and alternately tuned bells.  This piece features much sustain and space.

incompetech.title: Vulcan
incompetech.description: A mystical piece for Flutes, Bells, and Percussion.  Disjointed melodic flute in counterpoint with lower fluttery flutes, plodding  percussion, and shimmering bells. Same texture throughout piece.

incompetech.title: Blue Feather
incompetech.feel: Calming, Dark, Eerie, Mysterious, Relaxed, Somber, Unnerving
incompetech.description: Somber Solo Piano, with repetitive  descending arpeggio motive.  Contains uplifting moments, but generally sparse and mysterious.

incompetech.title: Kick Shock
incompetech.instruments: Synth Keys, Synth Drums, Triangle, Electronics
incompetech.description: Poppy electronic dance piece, thick with synths and phasing.  Strong lead synth melody in beginning, ends with exposed drum part.

incompetech.title: Laconic Granny
incompetech.description: Lumbering tuba-driven tune with heavy back beat appropriate for character underscore. Ends Abruptly.

incompetech.title: One Sly Move
incompetech.instruments: Electric Piano, Drum Kit, Synths, Guitar
incompetech.description: A slow, relaxed, electronic piece.  This piece heavily uses EP and Synths.  From 1:01 to 1:20 all goes silent except the EP.  Mainly a synth and EP piece, guitar and kit in the background.

incompetech.title: On the Passing of Time
incompetech.description: A slow somber piano piece. Small amount of reverb to the notes.  Ends early, last 20 seconds dedicated to a fadeout.

incompetech.title: Flutey Funk
incompetech.description: Starts off strong with bass, kit and flute.  Flute taking melody throughout the piece.  Bass and kit in the background throughout, however bass is prominent over kit.

incompetech.title: Just Nasty
incompetech.instruments: Electric Piano, Drum Kit, Organ, Trumpet, Trombone, Tenor Sax, Bari Sax
incompetech.description: A driving funk piece that is sometimes distorted because it plays with clashing grooves. EP prominent throughout the entire piece. Kit mainly in the background. Horn section accompanies EP in several places, however is not used equally throughout.

incompetech.title: Sunshine
incompetech.description: A bright piece with piano and rhythm guitar throughout.  Kit and Bass in the background.  Main melody carried by Piano.

incompetech.title: Frost Waltz
incompetech.instruments: Celesta, Glockenspiel, Basses, Cellos, Violas, Violins, French Horns
incompetech.description: A calm buy mysterious composition that uses Glockenspiel and Celesta throughout.  French Horns and Bass intercede throughout to accompany the Glockenspiel and Celesta.  Violin and Viola in the background throughout the piece.

incompetech.title: Heavy Interlude
incompetech.instruments: Bouzouki, Hammer Dulcimer, Violin, Basses, Cellos, Violas, Percussion
incompetech.description: A short, bouncy, medieval sounding piece with heavy use of Bouzouki and Hammer Dulcimer.  Strings used in the background, main melody carried by Violin and Hammer Dulcimer.

incompetech.title: Blipotron
incompetech.description: An electronica piece with lots of beeps intermittently throughout.  Starts slowly, intensifies after 46 seconds. Strong bass beats in the background after 46 seconds.

incompetech.title: BlockMan
incompetech.description: An eerie piece featuring synths.  Great for ambiance.  Starts light, gets progressively eerier and more mysterious.  Climaxes at the end, finishes with a single beat.

incompetech.title: Decay
incompetech.description: A very dark piece heavily featuring cymbal and bells.  Frequent Cymbal usage creates unnerving feeling.  3:08 prolonged trombone.  Lasts almost 30 seconds.  This piece is great for an eerie atmosphere.

incompetech.title: Longing and Concern
incompetech.instruments: French Horns, Trombones, Flute, Woodblock, Trumpet, Strings
incompetech.description: This is a great calm piece, featuring horns in the beginning, moving to flute.  Piece ends with a short fanfare with the trumpet and strings.  Fanfare begins at 1:03.

incompetech.title: Machinations
incompetech.instruments: Snare, Bass Drum, Tuba, Trombones, Bassoon, English Horn, Oboe, Strings
incompetech.description: A driving piece with heavy usage of the tuba in the background providing a constant beat throughout the piece.  English Horns and Oboe's have small role in the middle of the piece.  Strings used throughout.

incompetech.title: Nothing Broken
incompetech.instruments: Clarinets, Flute, Harpsichord, Guitar, Organ, Drum Kit
incompetech.description: An uplifting very happy happy piece.  Clarinets and flutes open.  Main piece begins at 00:20.  Great for happy situations.

incompetech.title: Pure Attitude
incompetech.instruments: Synths, Drum Kit, Strings, Harp, Brass
incompetech.description: A bouncy electronica piece heavily featuring strings and synths.

incompetech.title: Road to Hell
incompetech.description: A slow dark piece featuring a piano, bass duet.  Begins with bass, then immediately piano comes in.  Piece has continuous bass with piano coming in and out.  Finishes with prolonged bass note.

incompetech.title: Danse of Questionable Tuning
incompetech.description: Interesting piano and cello piece.  As title suggests, there is some questionable tuning.  Piece begins with piano, brings in cello around 00:05, both continue until the end of the piece.

incompetech.title: Texture for Violincello and Pianoforte No. 2
incompetech.filename: Texture for Violincello and Pianoforte No. 2.mp3
incompetech.description: An interesting jumble of cello and some piano fused together to create an eerie and intense piece the likes of which no one has ever heard of...until now.

incompetech.title: Cool Intro
incompetech.description: A cool short intro written for a writing podcast. Kit and bass used throughout.  Organ used mainly in the beginning.

incompetech.title: Double O
incompetech.description: A weird medley containing synths.  Recorded beats throughout.  Starting at 1:30 human speech saying "Double O" is used.  Continues for the next 30 seconds.

incompetech.title: The Second Coming Instrumental
incompetech.instruments: Drum Kit, Trombones, French Horns, Strings
incompetech.description: A sound track piece with Kit and Trombones/French Horns throughout.

incompetech.title: The Second Coming
incompetech.instruments: Drum Kit, Trombones, French Horns, Strings
incompetech.description: A sound track piece with Kit and Trombones/French Horns throughout.  This piece includes sections from a public domain (librivox) reading of "The Second Coming."

incompetech.title: Mighty and Meek
incompetech.instruments: Trumpets, Trombones, Horns, Tubas, Oboe, Bassoon, Clarinet, Flutes, Timpani, Snare, Percussion, Strings
incompetech.description: An epic piece involving lots of parallel chordal movement.  All Horns throughout. Trumpets used mainly for the fanfare type bits.

incompetech.title: Cold Funk
incompetech.instruments: Guitar, Bass, Drum Kit, Electric Piano, Bells
incompetech.description: A calming rock piece.  Repeated guitar chords as well as bass throughout.  Very light use of bells.  Great for looping if needed.

incompetech.title: Trips It
incompetech.description: A driving electronic piece.  Kit is dominant throughout the piece.  Choir has brief moments about 55 secs in, and re-emerging for a heavier role towards the end half of the piece.

incompetech.title: Surf Inspector
incompetech.description: Bouncy piece, usable in spy setting.  Stays similar throughout, easily looped, if necessary.

incompetech.title: Malt Shop Bop
incompetech.instruments: Guitar, Bass, Drum Kit, Saxes, Piano
incompetech.description: 1950's era peppy rock piece with nice brushed drum work. Piano solo is sort of bluesy. Modulation.

incompetech.title: Sock Hop
incompetech.description: 1950's era simple rock with tremolo lead guitar and vibraphone. Almost surf music.

incompetech.title: Exciting Trailer
incompetech.feel: Action, Aggressive, Dark, Driving, Epic, Intense
incompetech.description: A militaristic snare drum march begins this piece, reminiscent of Eastern Europe during World War II. The orchestral sounds blend with the sharpness of the brass throughout, but especially after 0:36, when the music is lyrical and melodic, though intensely emotional and suspenseful. At 0:52, the rhythmic march begins again, with the strings playing the melody and the brass reaching discordant, swelling heights until the final crescendo at 1:10.

incompetech.title: Somewhere Sunny
incompetech.description: Simple, clean guitar duet.

incompetech.title: DD Groove
incompetech.description: Very laid-back piece that may be indicative of a loss, or possibly carelessness.

incompetech.title: Hero Theme
incompetech.description: A short, powerful theme with a bit of hope.

incompetech.title: Piano Between
incompetech.description: Just a light piano piece for linking scenes.

incompetech.title: Bad Ideas (clean)
incompetech.description: Clean, unaltered pure recording of this piece (see also distressed version).

incompetech.title: Bad Ideas (distressed)
incompetech.description: Distressed (1930's era vinyl) version.

incompetech.title: Dark Hallway (distressed)
incompetech.description: Distressed (1930's era vinyl) version of this piece. 2 sections; one choppy, and one smooth.

incompetech.title: Dark Hallway (clean)
incompetech.description: Clean version of this piece. 2 sections; one choppy, and one smooth. (see also distressed)

incompetech.title: Memory Lane
incompetech.description: Casual, quiet piano solo for those introspective moments. 3/4

incompetech.title: Ujangong Mix
incompetech.description: An epic clash of genre that feigns coherence. Based on the Public Domain 1904 recording of "Ujangong (Mask Dance)" from New Guinea. But with a swing bass and slicing techno chunk in 3/4 time.

incompetech.title: Happy Alley
incompetech.description: Very upbeat and peppy piece with an usual bridge, all driven by an acoustic guitar.

incompetech.title: Dissappointment
incompetech.description: Very slow piece featuring bass clarinet with a couple of backing double basses.

incompetech.title: Firmament
incompetech.description: An interesting mix of rock, reggae with a more than average bit of swing to it. Three distinct snare drums give it character.

incompetech.title: Backed Vibes (clean)
incompetech.description: Cool background jazz sound.

incompetech.title: Monster Promenade
incompetech.description: "What a fun harmonic rollercoaster on the new tune!" Reminiscent of a carnival, this is an intentionally clashing harmonic piece... yet somehow very fun and quirky.

incompetech.title: Overheat
incompetech.description: A slow, trance-inducing piece of minimalism with a touch of melody in parts.

incompetech.title: Revival
incompetech.instruments: Guitar, Bass, Electric Piano, Drum Kit
incompetech.description: So you're thinking of doing a revival tour, but you don't have a band to back up your inspirational speech? Good news, good news indeed. This piece starts very thin, and builds a couple of times.

incompetech.title: Feelin Good
incompetech.description: A super-peppy mindless strumming feel-good sort of piece.

incompetech.title: Funkorama
incompetech.instruments: Guitar, Bass, Drum Kit, Organ, Synth
incompetech.description: Clean audio mix with an interesting electronic drum kit and odd chord progressions. Nice grooving bass line.

incompetech.title: Guiton Sketch
incompetech.description: Very short and energetic piece - but it can be easily looped, the end lines up perfectly with the beginning.

incompetech.title: Tea Roots
incompetech.instruments: Bass, Drum Kit, Erhu, Organ, Guitar, Piano, Horns
incompetech.description: Almost straight-up reggae, but with a chinese folk violin in it.

incompetech.title: Classic Horror 1
incompetech.description: Solo piano, which is not in tune (traditionally speaking). 4/4 time with some asymmetries.

incompetech.title: Classic Horror 2
incompetech.description: 5/8 time gives this piano solo a really unsettling feel. It uses more of the range of the piano, and can be chopped up to suit scenes well.

incompetech.title: Classic Horror 3
incompetech.description: Alternate tuning is very apparent here, Deep voicing lends a very ominous quality. Sounds more like the mind of someone who is breaking.

incompetech.title: Dark Walk
incompetech.description: Simple motive countered by several striking dissonances.

incompetech.title: Long Note Four
incompetech.instruments: Piano, Choir, Violins, Basses, Percussion, Synths
incompetech.description: A fairly intense beginning with a small piano part I pulled from a thing I wrote last week (Trio for Piano Violin and Viola), followed by a very long section of not moving much.

incompetech.title: Ritual
incompetech.instruments: Alto Flute, Bass Flute, Synths, Percussion
incompetech.description: Very very slow piece featuring the alto flute.

incompetech.title: The Rule
incompetech.instruments: Trumpets, French Horns, Trombones, Tuba, Bells, Timpani
incompetech.description: I sort of regal opening brass fanfare. It is meant to join at the end with another piece of music... which has not been written yet. This works as a stand-alone opening for most anything.

incompetech.title: Unnatural Situation
