incompetech.description: Piano with a tape delay and lots of dark colour in the background.

incompetech.title: Achilles
incompetech.instruments: French Horns, Trumpets, Trombones, Percussion, Strings
incompetech.description: Written as theme music for an epic drama. This starts broad and kicks into awesome at 0:27.

incompetech.title: Bass Vibes
incompetech.description: This piece gets a little atonal in parts.

incompetech.title: Takeover of the 8-bit Synths
incompetech.description: This... uhh... hmm... let's call it 'experimental' piece starts out with vanilla guitar and rock drums, and gets progressively crazier as the 8-bit synths take over the piece. Maximum anarchy starts around the 3-minute point.

incompetech.title: Trio for Piano Violin and Viola
incompetech.filename: Trio for Piano Violin and Viola.mp3
incompetech.description: An unfinished trio in 2 main parts.

incompetech.title: Piece for Disaffected Piano One
incompetech.description: I hesitate to assign a 'feel' to this because it is so exotic. It uses a 19 semitone scale which does not repeat at the octave. There are 9 semitones to a perfect fifth. The tuning is Wendy Carlos' "Alpha" scale. The piano strings are laid to horrible pain in sections as two octaves of keyboard are used to represent a doubling of frequency.

incompetech.title: Piece for Disaffected Piano Two
incompetech.description: Like "PfDP One", this piece also uses the Alpha scale developed by Wendy Carlos. Improvising on this piano is like walking in a minefield. There are many places to step which are just fine, but every now and again you find a surprise. This piece is light, and even comical in parts - with some musical revelations in between.

incompetech.title: Comic Plodding
incompetech.description: Impromptu.

incompetech.title: Impromptu in Blue
incompetech.description: Impromptu performed on a Steinway Model D tuned to Quarter Comma Meantone. In this piece the most out-of-tune notes give it a feel that is not often heard in contemporary piano music.

incompetech.title: Impromptu in Quarter Comma Meantone
incompetech.description: Impromptu performed on a Steinway Model D tuned to Quarter Comma Meantone. This gives a very rich feel to the base chords, but leaves a couple of "wolf notes" in the gaps (most notably in the Ab). 2 minutes in, it lingers on the most out-of tune part of the scales.

incompetech.title: Sovereign Quarter
incompetech.description: A re-recording of an older piece of mine on a new sample set of a Steinway Model D. This one is tuned to Quarter Comma Meantone (and not standard Equal Temperament).  In this piece, it gives an unerringly warm feel, as the notes that would be least in tune in this are never used.

incompetech.title: Confused State
incompetech.instruments: Percussion, Marimba, Kalimba, Bassoon, Clarinet, Oboe
incompetech.description: Interesting mallet-only section in the middle that sort of has a dreamy-yet earthy feel to it.

incompetech.title: End of the Era
incompetech.description: Alto Flute along with the low brass in the beginning, switching to strings. Final sounds are more harsh than the beginning. Ends with a tiny flourish.

incompetech.title: Exotic Battle
incompetech.description: Definite African influence on this mostly orchestral piece. Clean ending.

incompetech.title: Ignosi
incompetech.instruments: Trombones, Basses, Flutes, Clarinet, Marimba, Percussion, Horn, Violins, Violas
incompetech.description: Starts without percussion, then adds in a groove later on.

incompetech.title: Infados
incompetech.description: Thins out at 1:30, then adds in and accelerates, dropping back down for another build. Abrupt ending.

incompetech.title: Myst
incompetech.instruments: Oboe, Trombones, Clarinet, Percussion, Strings, Choir, Flute
incompetech.description: Theme from "AngloZulu" expanded on, but in a more relaxed sense.

incompetech.title: News of Sorrow
incompetech.description: African-influenced short piece with continuous accelerando.

incompetech.title: Night Cave
incompetech.description: Loose groove with a nice active bell part, and an overloud kalimba.

incompetech.title: Psychedelic Crater
incompetech.description: Harsh yet simple piece. The main theme was played with a wiimote, so don't expect too much expression! Extra interest kicks in at 1:35.

incompetech.title: Witch Hunt
incompetech.instruments: Percussion, Low Brass, Violins, Winds, French Horn
incompetech.description: Several feel changes from strictly percussive to full orchestral. Ends on a piercing high.

incompetech.title: Gagool
incompetech.description: A very nice piece with repeated themes... not sure what one should expect, given the instrumentation of this piece - but it probably won't disappoint.

incompetech.title: Militaire Electronic
incompetech.description: Snare line with quads and a bass line add marching flair for an electronic groove.

incompetech.title: Phat Sketch
incompetech.description: Sizzling fat analog bass line with a little beat.

incompetech.title: Vintage Education
incompetech.description: Intended to imitate the style of the 1970's educational programming.

incompetech.title: Arid Foothills
incompetech.instruments: Percussion, Marimba, Basses, Trombones, Tuba, French Horn
incompetech.description: Slight polyrhythms grow in the piece as it gains intensity. It eases back down at 2:30.

incompetech.title: Expeditionary
incompetech.description: A sort of African/European salad mix of sounds.

incompetech.title: Flutey Sting
incompetech.description: Slight slow down in tempo on the end.

incompetech.title: Keystone Deluge
incompetech.description: This piece has 3 major sections, all of which are large and violent.

incompetech.title: Light Sting
incompetech.description: Ascending melody.

incompetech.title: Monkoto
incompetech.description: Clashing time signatures, but a cohesive piece.

incompetech.title: Mourning Song
incompetech.description: Long broad notes with a solo oboe.

incompetech.title: Mystery Sting
incompetech.description: Slow groove percussion under an exotic melody.

incompetech.title: Serpentine Trek
incompetech.instruments: Flute, Clarinet, Bass Clarinet, Alto Flute, Violin, Percussion
incompetech.description: Something winding its way somewhere.

incompetech.title: Water Droplets on the River
incompetech.description: 6/8 piece meant to be reminiscent of nice memories from long ago.

incompetech.title: Back on Track
incompetech.description: A percussion-loaded piece with a cut out in the middle for dialog (or whatever you like).

incompetech.title: Bumbly March
incompetech.instruments: Tuba, Trombones, Pizzicato Violas, Snare, Bass Drum
incompetech.description: Lumbering brassy march.

incompetech.title: Long Note Three
incompetech.description: A very long dark note. Use under dialog, or to kill site noise.

incompetech.title: Majestic Hills
incompetech.description: Several feel, tempo, and instrumentation changes throughout this orchestral piece.

incompetech.title: Backed Vibes
incompetech.description: Cool background jazz sound with additional mechanical clicks and beeping.

incompetech.title: Flighty Theme
incompetech.description: Fun little piece played very poorly.

incompetech.title: Long Note Two
incompetech.description: Heavy effects on an arhythmic piano, and very deep bass.

incompetech.title: Some Amount of Evil
incompetech.instruments: Clarinets, Bass Clarinet, Xylophone, Strings, Piano
incompetech.description: Starts at a fast pace, and slows.

incompetech.title: Long note One
incompetech.description: Just a very long pad for use under dialog.

incompetech.title: Music Box Theme
incompetech.description: Very simple theme voiced in very very high and bright registers.

incompetech.title: Tiny Fugue
incompetech.description: A very short fugal theme. (3-part imitative counterpoint)

incompetech.title: Dangerous
incompetech.feel: Action, Dark, Driving, Eerie, Epic, Intense, Unnerving
incompetech.description: Crescendo and sting at the end.

incompetech.title: Griphop
incompetech.description: Sort of hip-hop rap beat with a giant backing string section.

incompetech.title: Lachaim
incompetech.instruments: Drum Kit, Bass, Guitar, Clarinet, Trombone, Sax, Violin
incompetech.description: Klezmer band arrangement.

incompetech.title: AngloZulu
incompetech.instruments: Percussion, English Horn, Choir, Brass, Strings, Flute
incompetech.description: A collision of musical traditions put together in an epic theme.

incompetech.title: Dreamlike
incompetech.description: Dark, creepy theme with a modulation about 2/3 of the way in.

incompetech.title: Lone Harvest
incompetech.instruments: Piano, Harp, Violin, Basses, Clarinet, Flute
incompetech.description: It looks like an uncommon mix of descriptive words, but this simple piece does a good job of displaying complex emotion.

incompetech.title: Stages of Grief
incompetech.description: That sort of "I'm kind of 'ok', but I'm still standing out in the rain feel". Pretty depressing for being in a major key.

incompetech.title: Cantina Blues
incompetech.description: Interesting mix of styles.

incompetech.title: Epic Unease
incompetech.description: Starts quiet, ends fortissimo brass.

incompetech.title: Gnarled Situation
incompetech.instruments: Xylophone, Choir, Organ, Strings, Percussion, Flutes
incompetech.description: Builds with a climax, then calm ending in flutes.

incompetech.title: Tango de Manzana
incompetech.instruments: Piano, Bass, Drums, Flute, Violin, Accordion
incompetech.description: A tango in 2 chords.

incompetech.title: Grave Blow
incompetech.description: We're dealing with a dark tragedy here... sounds like something needs to be done!

incompetech.title: Interloper
incompetech.feel: Action, Dark, Eerie, Epic, Intense, Mysterious, Suspenseful, Unnerving
incompetech.description: Multi-part cue that builds as it accelerates.

incompetech.title: The Chamber
incompetech.feel: Dark, Eerie, Epic, Mystical, Suspenseful, Unnerving
incompetech.instruments: Harps, Bass Clarinet, Bassoon, Low Brass, Strings, Choir, Percussion
incompetech.description: Delicate start with a lush ending.

incompetech.title: Chase
incompetech.description: Several mode changes made for an action-like chase scene.

incompetech.title: Dark Dance
incompetech.instruments: Violin, Glockenspiel, Strings, Flutes, Piano, Trombones, Tuba
incompetech.description: Winds, piano, and brass come in very late. The piece accelerates to the end.

incompetech.title: Supernatural
incompetech.description: A quick little piece to bring out supernatural elements.

incompetech.title: Asian Drums
incompetech.description: A semi-chaotic mix of drums with nice reverb.

incompetech.title: Almost in F
incompetech.description: Very long, very slow, trance-inducing piece... 36 cents sharp of the key of F. Yes, there is a good reason for that. No, I'm not going to explain it.

incompetech.title: Fluidscape
incompetech.description: Very long, cool, relaxed piece - no surprises, though the timbre does change from time to time.

incompetech.title: Klockworx
incompetech.description: This piece is in a genre sort of made by an electronic instrument from Yamaha called the Tenori-On (though it was not made on one of them). It is a sixteenth note-quantized all-synth 4 bar repeated thing. Items are only added, never removed.

incompetech.title: Wish Background
incompetech.instruments: Piano, Strings, Bells, Celesta, Brass Ensemble
incompetech.description: A sort of holiday backdrop. Variations on a traditional holiday piece. Modulations every 5 minutes or so. VERY LARGE FILE.

incompetech.title: Electro (Sketch)
incompetech.description: This is NOT a complete piece. It is only a sketch developed as a test for a stage production (repeated many times).  If you only need a few seconds, it is fine. Smooth rich synths fill in a nice syncopated hook.

incompetech.title: Greko (Sketch)
incompetech.description: This is NOT a complete piece. It is only a sketch developed as a test for a stage production (repeated many times).  If you only need a few seconds, it is fine. This is a hybrid of latin, greek, and R+B... as best I can figure.

incompetech.title: Savannah (Sketch)
incompetech.description: This is NOT a complete piece. It is only a sketch developed as a test for a stage production (repeated many times).  If you only need a few seconds, it is fine. Loping feel in 3/4 time.

incompetech.title: Smash (Sketch)
incompetech.description: This is NOT a complete piece. It is only a sketch developed as a test for a stage production (repeated many times).  If you only need a few seconds, it is fine. This piece has a harsh ting-y electric piano on top.

incompetech.title: Blue Sizzle
incompetech.description: Synth Pad with several swells.

incompetech.title: Chase Pulse Faster
incompetech.description: Same theme as "Chase Pulse" but with added percussion and a quicker pace.

incompetech.title: Chase Pulse
incompetech.description: Measured pace in low registers that just doesn't stop.

incompetech.title: Cherry Blossom
incompetech.description: A non-offensive, non-obtrusive piece to go under anything that feels a little flat.

incompetech.title: Deep Noise
incompetech.description: Could be breathing, could be the wind, it is very dark, and kind of disturbing.

incompetech.title: Night Break
incompetech.description: Edgy-sounding synths with several pulsing band-pass sweeps.

incompetech.title: Seven March
incompetech.description: A piece in 7/8 time with 2-measure phrasing. Very dark and round sounding with randomly placed percussions.

incompetech.title: Very Low Note
incompetech.description: Just a very low note (a C) to be used as a bed for any very unnerving and dark scene.

incompetech.title: Bright Wish
incompetech.description: A quick, bright piano piece with no pedaling.

incompetech.title: AhDah
incompetech.instruments: Electric Piano, Percussion, Voice, Synth, Organ
incompetech.description: A tight slightly funky EP and drum machine driven piece featuring female voice.

incompetech.title: Chill
incompetech.description: Bass feature piece with some rich laid-back synth, and a thin-sounding drum machine.

incompetech.title: Future Cha Cha
incompetech.description: Almost disco, almost techno, almost falls apart (but it doesn't). Dance, dance, dance. It feels like a piece that you'd kick off a party with. Lots and lots of bass. Solid 140BPM for mixing goodness.

incompetech.title: Reign
incompetech.instruments: Piano, Basses, French Horn, Drum Kit, Guitar, Choir
incompetech.description: A piece in two parts. Slow piano intro, and then a giant power section at 1 minute 50 seconds in. Written for an animation piece.

incompetech.title: Spy Groove
incompetech.instruments: Drum Kit, Organ, Bass, Cellos, Conga, Electric Piano, Violin
incompetech.description: Aggressive drum kit sound with warmth added by a B3 organ and conga. Modulation in the final repeat.

incompetech.title: Opium
incompetech.description: Slow, dreamy, droning piece that has a trance-inducing effect.

incompetech.title: Hand Balance Redux
incompetech.description: Intense, slightly urban piece with rich chordal melodies.

incompetech.title: We Wish you a Merry Christmas
incompetech.instruments: Oboe, Celesta, Violin, Clarinet, Piano, Strings, Brass, Glockenspiel, Drum Kit
incompetech.description: Starts out slowly and accelerates as it builds.

incompetech.title: Deck the Halls B
incompetech.instruments: Piano, Clarinet, Guitar, Flute, Drum Kit, Tuba
incompetech.description: Repeating, peppy sing-along version of the holiday classic.

incompetech.title: Oh, Christmas Tree
incompetech.description: Slightly jazzy quick sing-along.

incompetech.title: Up on a Housetop
incompetech.instruments: Piano, Tuba, Drum Kit, Bari Sax, Tenor Saxes
incompetech.description: Super-bouncy holiday sing-along.

incompetech.title: Eyes Gone Wrong
incompetech.description: How wrong? Guess you'll need to find out.

incompetech.title: NewsSting
incompetech.description: Your favorite news channel from 10 years ago.

incompetech.title: Vibe Ace
incompetech.description: Starts more synthy ends more organic.

incompetech.title: Bama Country
incompetech.instruments: Harmonica, Violin, Guitar, Bass, Drum Kit, Accordion
incompetech.description: Deep South-type country music.

incompetech.title: Colossus
incompetech.instruments: Percussion, Brass, English Horn, Alto Flute, Bass Clarinet, Bassoons
incompetech.description: Nice mid-level orchestral action piece. Culmination at 3:43.

incompetech.title: Folk Round
incompetech.instruments: Guitar, Violin, Recorder, Piccolo, Percussion, Accordion
incompetech.description: A simple folk perpetual canon - also known as a round. Feels like a medieval campfire piece.

incompetech.title: Frozen Star
incompetech.description: Lilting gentle feel with odd chord progressions.

incompetech.title: Halls of the Undead
incompetech.instruments: Pipe Organ, Percussion, Choir, Oboe, Tubas, Trombones, Chimes, French Horns
incompetech.description: Deep dark background undercurrent.

incompetech.title: Rumination
incompetech.description: After everything is said and done and you have time to look back, this piece unfolds like one's mind coming to terms with situations of gravity.

incompetech.title: Shamanistic
incompetech.instruments: Percussion, Bass Flute, Alto Flute, Xylophone, Synths, Strings
incompetech.description: Earthy, yet unearthly. Deep and rich with things amiss.

incompetech.title: Stoneworld Battle
incompetech.instruments: Percussion, Tubas, Trombones, French Horns, Baritones, Strings
incompetech.description: Giant movie battle sound kicks in at 2:00 with the finale starting at 2:50.

incompetech.title: The Machine Thinks
incompetech.description: 100% electronic creepiness. Change from round and bleeping to harsh bleeping about 2 minutes in.

incompetech.title: Toccata and Fugue in D Minor
incompetech.filename: Toccata and Fugue in D Minor.mp3
incompetech.description: J. S. Bach's most famous organ piece. BWV 565. (Beckerath German baroque pipe organ)

incompetech.title: Martian Cowboy
incompetech.description: Slow-moving synth textures. Glock starts at about 1:20, and the bass at 1:50

incompetech.title: Western Streets
incompetech.instruments: Snare, Tenor Drum, Timpani, Chimes, Gong
incompetech.description: An all percussion tension-sustaining piece... More chaotic than symmetric, but enough repeated themes to keep it cohesive.

incompetech.title: Beach Bum
incompetech.description: Typical surf-type music.

incompetech.title: Skye Cuillin
incompetech.instruments: Harp, Whistle, Fiddle, Synths, Strings, Choir
incompetech.description: New age and Celtic with super round synths and lots of delay.

incompetech.title: Smoking Gun
incompetech.instruments: Bass Guitar, Guitar, Choir, Flute, Strings
incompetech.description: Gritty Western feel with a touch of suspense.

incompetech.title: A Mission
incompetech.description: Highly orchestrated pulsing piece. High energy. Driven by strings and some low brass.

incompetech.title: Accralate
incompetech.description: African-inspired lazy drum ensemble. Feel change in the middle; Tempo change near the end. Lots of polyrhythms. This piece exhibits some phantom notes athat you hear, but don't really exist. Hard to explain. Batu, Conga, Marimba, Agogo, Cowbell, Clave.

incompetech.title: Achaidh Cheide
incompetech.description: Traditional Irish-sounding. I had a hard time classifying this in my existing feels. It feels like Irish folk music.

incompetech.title: Acid Trumpet
incompetech.description: Cool EP, muted trumpet, and a layed back bass.

incompetech.title: Action
incompetech.description: Underscore for a very dramatic scene with lots of cut-outs for dialog. Tubular bells, snare, tymp, etc are all at the fore. Might be difficult to use generically, but it is quite a good cue.

incompetech.title: Air Prelude
incompetech.description: Slow; lots of flutes; some digital synth for texture.

incompetech.title: Aitech
incompetech.description: Hard rock beat with electronic elements grooving in.

incompetech.title: Alien Restaurant
incompetech.description: Non-real instrumentation written as background music for a restaurant on another planet. Tribal, primitive, evolved. 4-tone scale.

incompetech.title: Ambush
incompetech.description: Dark curling undercurrent in winds and strings that breaks into cymbals at climax.

incompetech.title: An Upsetting Theme
incompetech.description: Double Basses and glockenspiel - with some cellos thrown in. Dark, dark, dark! This bit got removed from a soundtrack I recorded. I still like it!

incompetech.title: Anachronist
incompetech.description: Heavy rock sound... with a harpsichord as well. Unlike most of my music - this one it perfectly titled.

incompetech.title: And Awaken
incompetech.description: Sweet sounding French horns opposite clarinet with harps.

incompetech.title: Angels We Have Heard on High
incompetech.description: Slow and mellow.

incompetech.title: Anxiety
incompetech.description: Background horror music. Electronic.

incompetech.title: Apprehension
incompetech.description: Background horror music. Electronic. Sparse and grating.

incompetech.title: Arcadia
incompetech.feel: Eerie, Epic, Mysterious, Mystical, Unnerving, Uplifting
incompetech.description: Many choirs in a slow-moving ethereal progression.

incompetech.title: Aretes
incompetech.description: Solo piano surrounded by rich textures.

incompetech.title: Artifact
incompetech.description: Interesting multi-layered blend of percussion rhythms and acoustic guitar, which foreshadows the choir.

incompetech.title: As I Figure
incompetech.instruments: Drum Kit, Acoustic Guitar, Electric Piano, Tenor Sax, Bass
incompetech.description: Sort of Spanish, sort of Tom Waits. This one is hard to classify.

incompetech.title: Atlantean Twilight
incompetech.description: Time ticks away in a far away place in this little new-age piece.

incompetech.title: Attack of the Mole Men
incompetech.instruments: Orchestra, French Horns, Chimes, Tremolo Strings
incompetech.description: Written as an introduction to a play, this has the feel of a 1950's monster movie.

incompetech.title: Aunt Tagonist
incompetech.description: Tuba and trumpets with a sting at the end. 2 short versions included, one with trumpets and one without.

incompetech.title: Avant Jazz
incompetech.description: Filtered vibe and horns play against a relentless bass and percussion section.

incompetech.title: Awaiting Return
incompetech.description: Piano derivative of Holst's "Thaxted".

incompetech.title: Awesome Call
incompetech.instruments: Drum Kit, Bass, Piano, Electric Piano
incompetech.description: Light and bouncy.

incompetech.title: B-Roll
incompetech.description: Good drums, bass, and very good guitar technique.

incompetech.title: Babylon
incompetech.description: Smooth chorused delay-drenched bass with lots of cool delayed drumming, and a smattering of high register instruments for interest. Cool, yet intense... or concerning.

incompetech.title: Take Me Out to the Ballgame
incompetech.description: Ballpark organ playing the peppy classic.

incompetech.title: Balzan Groove
incompetech.description: Starts out traditional, moves to all-electronic, then a combination of the two.

incompetech.title: Barroom Ballet
incompetech.description: Simple I-V-V-I staccato piano duet.

incompetech.title: Bass Soli
incompetech.description: Solo electric bass with added chorus effect. Nice, round and (of course) low.

incompetech.title: Bathed in the Light
incompetech.description: Super light with some sweet cutting sounds. Round, full, and slow.

incompetech.title: Oh, Little Town of Bethlehem
incompetech.description: Texturally thick in parts.

incompetech.title: Big Mojo
incompetech.feel: Action, Dark, Driving, Epic, Grooving, Intense, Mystical
incompetech.instruments: Percussion, Koto, Strings, Flute, Misc Orchestral, Electronic
incompetech.description: Big grooving percussion loop with a massive bass kick that will rattle teeth. It starts out with high and low shelves, and kicks in at around 30 seconds. Big ending.

incompetech.title: Big Rock
incompetech.description: Big fat power chord chunking rock.

incompetech.title: Blue Scorpion
incompetech.instruments: Drums, Kalimba, Dulcimer, Synths, Drum Kit, Guitar
incompetech.description: An odd mix of African pseudo-polyrhythm and modern overdriven synths. Major feel changes at both 30 seconds and 2 minutes in.

incompetech.title: Brandenburg Concerto No. 4 in G, Movement I (Allegro), BWV 1049
incompetech.description: Bach. Violin, 2 Flutes (standard C Flute in this case), a mess of strings, and harpsichord. The primary violin is obviously sampled in a few of the faster passages, but the sweet tone shines through nicely on the slower notes. This is my first attempt at a Brandenburg... I suspect I'll revisit this one after I get a few more recorded. Still, it is probably the best free and digital recording available.

incompetech.title: Breaktime
incompetech.description: Slower, solo piano version of the "Look Busy" piece (found elsewhere on this site).

incompetech.title: Canon in D Major
incompetech.description: Pachelbel's Canon in D Major. Bass continuo with three violins. Harp duet doubling the parts.

incompetech.title: Cartoon Battle
incompetech.description: Mongolean sort of battle music. Quite over-the-top.

incompetech.title: Cello Suite #1 in G - Prelude
incompetech.description: Bach's famous cello suite as played on a dulcimer. BWV 1007

incompetech.title: Celtic Impulse
incompetech.instruments: Hammer Dulcimer, Harp, Bouzouki, Tin Whistle
incompetech.description: Simple, easy-to-play folk-influenced tune in the D Dorian mode (related to D Minor).

incompetech.title: Children's Theme
incompetech.description: Progressively darker and darker version of "This Old Man".

incompetech.title: Chipper
incompetech.description: Simple simple simple distortion guitar rock; no solos, no highlights; make up your own words if you're so inclined.

incompetech.title: Chromatic Fuge (Bach BWV 930)
incompetech.description: Bach. Among the most complex fugues ever written.

incompetech.title: Chromatic Fantasia (Bach BWV 930)
incompetech.description: Bach. WARNING! This is a very baroque organ piece. It sounds very old. Not something you listen to unless you're into that kind of thing.

incompetech.title: Chucky the Construction Worker
incompetech.description: Modern children's TV theme. Written for a stage performance. Peppy and mildly electronic.

incompetech.title: Circus Waltz
incompetech.description: General-purpose upbeat piece which can be used in general dialog.

incompetech.title: Clear Waters
incompetech.description: Simple and light of weight solo.

incompetech.title: Cognitive Dissonance
incompetech.description: Main theme used in two different treatments. Specifically designed to turn your brain around... one sort of gets lost in the fog in the middle, and ends up pointing the wrong way by the end. Starts with a very long slow fade.

incompetech.title: Comedic Juggernaut
incompetech.instruments: Timpani, Brass, Saxes, Clarinet, Drum Kit, String Section
incompetech.description: New Orleans style meets Spike Jones... sort of.

incompetech.title: Comfortable Mystery
incompetech.description: Solo vintage electric piano. Not quite supernatural... more like surreal. Slow with descending arpeggios.

incompetech.title: Comic Hero
incompetech.description: Tuba carries the character of the piece.

incompetech.title: No Frills Comparsa
incompetech.instruments: Drum Kit, Bass, Electric Guitar, Piano, Flute, Bari Sax, Tenor Sax, Trumpet
incompetech.description: A basic comparsa.

incompetech.title: Consequence
incompetech.description: Moderately paced driving composition featuring xylophone and cowbell. No, I'm not kidding.

incompetech.title: Continue Life
incompetech.description: Solo new-age piano.

incompetech.title: Cool Blast
incompetech.description: Sort of dance, sort of jazz.

incompetech.title: Cool Hard Facts
incompetech.description: Tight drums and power guitars... in some trapezoid of death. Synth-y Ending.

incompetech.title: Cool Rock
incompetech.description: Cool, yet energetic rock. Mostly kit and bass.

incompetech.title: Creeping to Ship
incompetech.description: Low brass / bassoons with pizz. Mild stings on the end. (written for Darker Projects' Falcon Banner Episode 4)

incompetech.title: Crisis
incompetech.description: A very serious and straight dark orchestral piece. Tubular bells, bass trombone, and bass drum add a lot of low-end.

incompetech.title: Cryptic Sorrow
incompetech.description: Sad solo piano with a "reality" feel. Uneven meters.

incompetech.title: No Frills Cumbia
incompetech.instruments: Drum Kit, Bass, Acoustic Guitar, Piano, Organ, Flute
incompetech.description: A basic cumbia.

incompetech.title: Cut Trance
incompetech.description: Semi-trance, semi-techno with a couple of touches of piano. Pretty driving for being so slow. Super super clean mix that'll rattle your walls.

incompetech.title: Dance Monster
incompetech.description: A remix of one of my own pieces "120 BPM Monster" by special request. This one is longer, and more sharply mixed.

incompetech.title: Dance of Deception
incompetech.description: Pipe organ piece. This is apparently a 'Czardas', a traditional Hungarian folk dance. I would like to thank Keith for the info.

incompetech.title: Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairies
incompetech.filename: Dance Of The Sugar Plum Fairies.mp3
incompetech.description: Tchaikovsky's famous dance from the Nutcracker Suite.

incompetech.title: Dark Pad
incompetech.description: This is a dark and eerie arrhythmic thing with deep lows and cutting highs. Experimental only in the personal sense - I just got GarageBand, and I'm seeing what the (very nice) electronic effects can do.

incompetech.title: Dark Standoff
incompetech.description: Broad dark sustained chords in the low strings punctuated with slight percussion.

incompetech.title: Darkening Developments
incompetech.instruments: Percussion, Synth Bass, Bass Section, Oboe, Bassoon, Clarinet, Piccolo
incompetech.description: Bass is very VERY strong in this. Please make sure you master on a system capable of reproducing these notes. The end feel is decided different from the rest of the piece. It does an unnerving build to nowhere.

incompetech.title: Daybreak
incompetech.description: Solo vintage electric piano. Lounge/New Age.

incompetech.title: Daytime TV Theme
incompetech.description: Slow and deliberate.

incompetech.title: Dead Drop
incompetech.description: Super nice drum fills and guitar work. Deliberate pace... like someone is on a mission.

incompetech.title: Deck the Halls A
incompetech.description: Piano solo of the traditional holiday piece. Very smooth with seemingly random phrasing. This isn't really a sing-along type recording.

incompetech.title: Delay Rock
incompetech.description: Super simple guitar/bass/drums rock tune.

incompetech.title: Deliberate Thought
incompetech.description: Calming round electronic music with a nice delay... and a choir.

incompetech.title: Digital Bark
incompetech.description: Background horror music. Electronic. Kind of tech-horror sounding... Highly unnerving.

incompetech.title: Disconcerned
incompetech.description: Broad minor chords moving slowly in parallel. Reminds me of Holst.

incompetech.title: Dispersion Relation
incompetech.instruments: Drum Kit, Bass, Piano, Vibraphone, Trumpet, Flute
incompetech.description: A neat little upbeat jazz piece with a crazy bouncy bass and overactive drummer.

incompetech.title: Distant Tension
incompetech.description: Background horror music. Symphonic with some digital processing. Some tremolo basses in the beginning are meant to be removed and integrated on their own.

incompetech.title: Divertissement - Pizzicato (from the ballet Sylvia)
incompetech.description: Delibes. I am astounded that there are so few recordings of this piece on the net... for a few reasons.    1. Everyone knows this piece (but nearly no one knows what it is called).    2. It is very easy to record (Pizzicato strings have been one of the few samples that have sounded "real" for a long time).    3. The composer is long dead and his stuff is in the Public Domain (Léo Delibes; 1891). And for some background... Sylvia is a 3-Act ballet first produced in 1876. I'm pretty certain this particular piece has nothing to do with the plot - or it wouldn't be called a "divertissement".

incompetech.title: Doh De Oh
incompetech.description: Bass accompaniment only.

incompetech.title: Double Drift
incompetech.description: Loads of delay on the guitar give this piece a dark, yet comforting feel. All of the sounds are rounded, but the effect isn't.

incompetech.title: Double Polka
incompetech.description: Bouncy.

incompetech.title: Dragon and Toast
incompetech.instruments: Didgeridoo, Harp, Celesta, Bass, Cello, Violin, Bassoon, Contrabassoon, English Horn, Oboe, Percussion
incompetech.description: Minimalist-type piece.

incompetech.title: Duet Musette
incompetech.description: Folk sounds from the continent. This is not a traditional anything, just improvisation in two chords.

incompetech.title: Dvorak Polka
incompetech.description: Actual instruments - not the normal electronic ones.

incompetech.title: Earnest
incompetech.description: 6/8 apreggiations with a thin high melody.

incompetech.title: Earth Prelude
incompetech.description: Grounding background pad with melodic interest. Think "grassy plains".

incompetech.title: East of Tunesia
incompetech.description: Sort of based on Maltesian music. The primary horn in this piece is actually an effected sopranino sax with an oboe drone.

incompetech.title: Easy Jam
incompetech.instruments: Bass, Drum Kit, Guitar, Trumpet, Trombone, Flute
incompetech.description: Chilled out reggae with a brass section.

incompetech.title: Eighties Action
incompetech.description: Super 1980's-style synth action. Something like one might intro a sports team to, or maybe a late-night radio show. It picks up about 1/3 of the way in...

incompetech.title: El Magicia
incompetech.description: Every now and again I get a request that is so odd, I have to try it. This is hard driving guitar rock with traditional Spanish flair. Imagine Chriss Angel meets Los Del Rio for an in-your-face Spanish/stage magic performance. Thick and busy.

incompetech.title: Enigma
incompetech.description: Written as a theme for a podcast, this was requested as "upbeat with an air of mystery". So that's what it is.

incompetech.title: Enter the Party
incompetech.description: Simple, clean, light-yet-driving funk-type dance.

incompetech.title: Errigal

incompetech.title: Eternal Hope

incompetech.title: Ether Disco

incompetech.title: Evening Fall (Harp)

incompetech.title: Evening Fall (Piano)
incompetech.description: Impromptu

incompetech.title: Exotics

incompetech.title: Five Card Shuffle

incompetech.title: Fork and Spoon
incompetech.description: Super-funky organ piece.

incompetech.title: Four Beers' Polka

incompetech.description: Full polka ensemble. She's a peppy one, she is. Instrumental.

incompetech.description: Simple, calm, open piano impromptu.

incompetech.title: Friendly Day
incompetech.description: Most famously used in the film "Hugo".

incompetech.title: Funky One
incompetech.description: Kind of a funky-sounding beat.

incompetech.title: Gearhead
incompetech.description: A slow and rockin' piece with chunking distorted guitar with a confident and laid-back beat.

incompetech.description: High-energy polka with screaming trumpets and a clarinet "voice". Modulation at the end. Unusual turnarounds.

incompetech.title: Long Time Coming
incompetech.description: Tense and mercurial, ?Long Time Coming? begins with a slow, frenetic crescendo, and at 0:40 builds into the main melody with heavy percussion. At 1:04 the percussion is tacit, and at 1:18 a rippling crescendo builds to long, demented pulls on the string bass. The percussive beat begins again at 2:18, and then the frenzied, reverbed staccato of the piano enters, accompanied by a swelling synth lead. At 3:40 the piece finds it?s stride with pulsating synthesizer effects and a rumbling bass line. Best used as accompaniment for a tense, difficult level of a game or as the final battle with a villain. Because of its steady bass beat and snyth effects, this could also work well to depict a tense and suspenseful race to the finish, or as the music playing during a vibrant, pounding rave.

incompetech.title: The Way Out
incompetech.description: Understated intensity with a hair of creepiness.

incompetech.title: There is Romance
incompetech.description: Slow and poignant, this piece is excellent for depicting childhood love, the swelling love of adolescence, or the tender caresses of old age. The simple, elegant melody is exceptionally suitable to weddings, faith services, or as a theme to a story of lasting love.

incompetech.title: Thinking Out Loud
incompetech.description: Piano looped digital electronica hybrid. I started this piece in 2

incompetech.title: Time Passes
incompetech.description: Bittersweet and somewhat dark; ends brightly on an open major chord.

incompetech.title: Touching Moments Five - Circle
incompetech.description: A simple tour through every major key in order. Arpeggiated with some connecting melodic notes.

incompetech.title: Touching Moments Four - Melody
incompetech.description: More melodic than most of the pieces presented here - can be distracting, or can be just what you're looking for. Famous from the Sad Fairy Dress-up game.

incompetech.title: Touching Moments One - Pulse
incompetech.description: Open and airy. A classic "touching moment" style. Performance imperfections are exaggerated to give a more "choked up" feel.

incompetech.title: Touching Moments Three - Deeper
incompetech.description: A more 'gutsy' piece that explores more of the keyboard, and provides a more grounded and open feel.

incompetech.title: Touching Moments Two - Higher
incompetech.description: Only notes from the very highest registers of the piano are used in this. It can cut through ambient noise and still provide a presence.

incompetech.title: Touching Story
incompetech.description: Very very slow and changeable.

incompetech.title: Transition One
incompetech.instruments: Flute, Clarinet, Bass Clarinet, Bass, Cello, Viola, Violin, Glockenspiel, Harp
incompetech.description: Small calm transition; descending wind ensemble blending to ascending string ensemble.

incompetech.title: Trepidation
incompetech.description: Background horror music. Solo piano; low and loud.

incompetech.title: Trio for Piano, Cello, and Clarinet
incompetech.filename: Trio for Piano, Cello, and Clarinet.mp3
incompetech.description: More contemplative than outright depressing. Tempo is highly variable, so don't count on it if you have to synch to something. I didn't know there was a tradition of writing for this instrumentation. It works very well.

incompetech.title: Trouble
incompetech.description: Diminished chords, tremolo You'll recognize them.

incompetech.title: Two Together
incompetech.description: Sparkly open voicings.

incompetech.title: Unease
incompetech.description: Background horror music. Solo midrange piano.

incompetech.title: Variation on Egmont
incompetech.description: Kind of techno, with a mix in of themes from Beethoven's overture as played on piano.

incompetech.title: Vegas Glitz
incompetech.description: This sounds happier than anything with parallel chords should.

incompetech.title: Village Dawn
incompetech.description: Light piece in 5/8 time with a Lydian subsection.

incompetech.title: Vision of Persistence
incompetech.description: Rhythmically driven simple piece, high and sweet.

incompetech.title: Vortex
incompetech.description: Blatting brass ensemble. Uneven phrasing.

incompetech.title: Wagner Bridal Chorus - piano
incompetech.description: A newer piano variation on Wagner's Bridal Chorus. It leaves out some of the less familiar middle section, and changes up a few chords while retaining the melody.

incompetech.title: Wagner Bridal Chorus
incompetech.description: The classic "here come the bride" piece written by Wagner for the opera Lohengrin. This is about as traditional a performance as you can get.

incompetech.title: Walking Along
incompetech.description: Written as a laid-back background for a film where a calming feel was needed.

incompetech.title: Waltz (Tschikovsky Op. 40)
incompetech.description: Opus 40; Number 9. Written 1878. Recorded 2005.

incompetech.title: Waltz of Treachery
incompetech.description: Light but dim. Nice for a 'classy' villain with a plan.

incompetech.title: Water Prelude
incompetech.description: Smooth background music... Float-y feeling.

incompetech.title: Waunobe March
incompetech.instruments: Trumpets, Trombones, Tuba, Flutes, Clarinets, Piccolo, Snares, Bass Drum, Alto Sax, Tenor Sax, Bari Sax
incompetech.description: A simple march as played by a semi-competent 23-piece ensemble.

incompetech.title: We Got Trouble
incompetech.description: Super action, but still a bit restrained. Quite a long cue with a few changes on the inside.

incompetech.title: Weight of Responsibility
incompetech.instruments: French Horn, Trombone, Tuba, Trumpet, Cello, Viola
incompetech.description: Brass ensemble with a slight bit of strings. Deliberate chorale sounding, free conducted. Evocative of a sense of nobility and weariness. Loopable.

incompetech.title: Welcome to the Show
incompetech.instruments: Guitar, Bass, Drum Kit, Horns, Synth
incompetech.description: A one-chord wonder designed to open a show. It has a long lead out for fading. Modulation about halfway through.

incompetech.title: What Child is This
incompetech.description: Very very high and thin.

incompetech.title: Whimsy Groove
incompetech.description: Lighter and more fun small drum ensemble. Tumba, Conga, Quinto, Bells, and lots of Marimba.

incompetech.title: White
incompetech.description: Easy flowing with highly differentiated right and left hand parts.

incompetech.title: Winter Chimes
incompetech.description: Interesting piano solo with a repeated pedal in the right hand. Counterpoint on the final repeat.

incompetech.title: With the Sea
incompetech.description: Darker, slow and contemplative impromptu.

incompetech.title: Wizardtorium
incompetech.description: Very airy and eerie. Based off of a feel of Holst's 'Neptune'.

incompetech.title: Work is Work
incompetech.description: Light and cheery. Appropriate for nearly any application.

incompetech.title: Zombie Chase
incompetech.feel: Driving, Action, Unnerving, Dark, Mysterious, Suspenseful
incompetech.description: Aggressive, but smooth action sequence; earthy and powerful, using the same piano theme as Zombie Hoodoo.

incompetech.title: Zombie Hoodoo
incompetech.description: Simple piano line with dark atmospherics in the background. It says "Zombie", but it is useful for any number of creepy motifs. (This piece is related to Zombie Chase).

incompetech.title: Poofy Reel
incompetech.instruments: Bass, Guitar, Electric Piano, Drum Kit
incompetech.description: Funtastic little piece written for a movie trailer's more quirky section.

incompetech.title: C-Funk
incompetech.instruments: Bass, Drum Kit, Guitar, Bari Sax, Tenor Sax, Trumpet, Percussion
incompetech.description: More funk than disco, but more disco than rock. Bongos and guitar reminiscent of a certain genre of film from the 70's.
